raw.description:
A job at RAZR is like no other. We are on a mission to Be Relevant - make a meaningful difference in the lives of others. This talented team lives our values every day.  These values have made RAZR what it is for years, and today, they are more critical than ever. They keep us connected. They make us a team. They allow us to thrive. 

The RAZR Core Values You Live 

Be Intentional  

  • You take action and pursue the ultimate best outcome for RAZR and our clients 

  • You dig in and understand the details of how the business works 

  • You run towards, and you don’t run away 

  • You understand that “whatever it takes” is just that  

  • You have a plan, and you execute it even when you don’t feel like it 

Embrace the Attitude of How  

  • You understand that problems are simply opportunities to solve them 

  • You view commitments as promises to be kept...regardless 

  • You can’t stand not knowing; you have an unquenchable thirst to understand why 

  • You are an active participant, never a spectator 

  • You are focused on outcomes and not the time it takes to achieve them 

Enjoy the Ride 

  • You are grateful for both life’s challenges and opportunities 

  • You passionately pursue excellence in everything you do 

  • You laugh often and don’t take yourself too seriously 

  • You love change, and living in the gray is energizing to you 

  • You can't wait to get out of bed in the morning & get on with your day 

Overview

We're looking for an Enterprise Business Analyst to provide dedicated pre-production operational support for the Enterprise Loyalty implementation team as new capabilities are built and onboarded. This role creates scalable processes, documentation, and testing support that enable successful client implementations while freeing the delivery team to stay focused on execution.

This is intentionally a pre-production support role: you'll build the documentation, repeatable processes, and operational knowledge that lay the foundation for a future production support organization.

​​​​Reports To: Client Data & Platform Rules Product Owner

Location: Remote

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide dedicated pre-production operational support for the Enterprise Loyalty implementation team as new capabilities are built and onboarded.

  • Own day-to-day coordination of client testing activities.

  • Analyze inbound and outbound files to determine whether issues originate from client configuration or internal systems, and document findings through resolution.

  • Develop and maintain both internal support documentation and client-facing implementation guides.

  • Attend implementation team standups and stay aligned with ongoing development work.

  • Provide operational support to the Client Data & Platform Rules Product Owner and the broader Support organization.

  • Partner with QA on testing, validation, and issue triage.

Initial Priorities

  • Build and maintain internal support documentation and client-facing implementation guides.

  • Establish a rhythm for tracking and updating day-to-day changes across active implementations.

  • Attend implementation standups and stay current on ongoing development.

  • Serve as the operational point of contact during client testing and validation.

  • Process and analyze implementation files to determine root cause of issues (client vs. platform).

  • Establish repeatable testing, validation, troubleshooting, and issue-triage processes.

  • Partner with QA to align on testing standards.

What Success Looks Like

  • Fewer implementation bottlenecks, thanks to dedicated pre-production operational support.

  • A documented, repeatable operational process that reduces ad hoc firefighting during client testing and validation.

  • A scalable foundation that can evolve into a dedicated production support function, including future 24/7 operations support.

About Us 

RAZR is a fast-growing marketing technology company headquartered in the Twin Cities, and we count some of the world’s most recognized brands among our clients. Working across various industries, including healthcare, medical technology, financial services, and retail, we help our clients acquire, retain, and grow consumers by leveraging our proprietary technology platform, Fibonacci™.  The RAZR approach is rooted in behavioral science and combines strategy with visual design to create sustainable behavior change within consumer audiences. 

With our Clients, Colleagues, and in our Communities, we live our Mission - Be Relevant – “Make a meaningful difference in the lives of others.”  At the foundation of our Culture, you’ll find the Core Values of “Be Intentional”, “Embrace the Attitude of How”, and “Enjoy the Ride”, this is a mindset and a commitment to how we show up every day.  The RAZR team is driven to pursue the ultimate best outcome for our key constituents.  There are no jobs here, just opportunities to serve and make a material impact in the world. 

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer, and our employees have unique strengths, experiences, and backgrounds who share a passion for improving people's lives.

At Ping Identity, we're changing the way people and businesses think about cybersecurity, digital experiences, and identity and access management.

Working within a small, senior team of 3 engineers, you'll have high ownership, short feedback loops, and direct impact on mission-critical identity infrastructure. Sophos is a cybersecurity leader defending 600,000 organizations globally with an AI-driven platform and expert-led services. Sophos meets organizations wherever they are in their security maturity and grows with them to defeat cyberattacks. Its solutions combine machine learning, automation, and real-time threat intelligence with frontline human expertise from Sophos X-Ops to deliver advanced, 24/7 threat monitoring, detection, and response.
Sophos offers industry-leading managed detection and response (MDR) alongside a comprehensive portfolio of cybersecurity technologies — including endpoint, network, email, and cloud security, extended detection and response (XDR), identity threat detection and response (ITDR), and next-gen SIEM. Together with expert advisory services, these capabilities help organizations proactively reduce risk and respond faster, with the visibility and scalability needed to stay ahead of evolving threats.
Sophos goes to market with a global partner ecosystem, including Managed Service Providers (MSPs), Managed Security Service Providers (MSSPs), resellers and distributors, marketplace integrations, and cyber risk partners, giving organizations the flexibility to choose trusted relationships when securing their business. Sophos is headquartered in Oxford, U.K. More information is available at .

Role Summary

Sophos is looking for a Manager, Finance System Support to lead the team that keeps our core finance systems running smoothly and continuously improving. In this role, you will manage day-to-day support for SAP and related finance applications, oversee month-end close readiness, guide access management and controls, help deliver system enhancements that improve the experience for our global finance users, contribute to broader finance initiatives and cross-functional projects where finance systems, process, data, controls, or operational expertise is required, and support the development and adoption of AI-enabled initiatives that improve finance processes, insights, automation, and user experience. This is a great opportunity for an experienced people manager who combines finance systems knowledge, strong stakeholder management, and a practical, service-focused approach to solving complex operational problems.

What You Will Do

  • Lead, coach, and develop the Finance System Support team, setting priorities and ensuring high quality service across the finance systems landscape.
  • Own day to day support for key finance systems, ensuring incidents, requests, recurring issues, and escalations are managed effectively and transparently.
  • Oversee month end close support, including system readiness, critical process monitoring, issue resolution, and timely communication of risks or blockers.
  • Manage finance system access processes, including user requests, role governance, periodic reviews, segregation of duties considerations, and coordination with IT and control owners.
  • Partner with finance, IT, internal development teams, and external support providers to resolve complex issues, identify root causes, and deliver sustainable fixes.
  • Establish consistent support practices, documentation, controls, and user guidance across core finance processes, including AP, AR, inventory, fixed assets, general ledger, CRM, and BI reporting.
  • Lead and support finance systems initiatives that strengthen controls, improve efficiency, support integrations, and respond to evolving business and compliance needs.
  • Oversee requirements gathering, testing, change readiness, user communication, and post-implementation support for enhancements and new initiatives.
  • Coordinate the quarterly release cycle for finance system priorities, from intake and prioritization through testing, deployment readiness, and communication of impacts.
  • Ensure finance systems remain aligned with business, audit, compliance, and control requirements while balancing stability, usability, and scalable process design.
  • Serve as an escalation point for finance leaders and business partners on system-related questions, process issues, controls, and support priorities.

What You Will Bring

  • Experience working with finance or accounting processes, with the ability to understand operational workflows, controls, accounting impacts, and system-related risks.
  • Previous people management experience is required, including experience leading, coaching, prioritizing work, managing escalations, and improving team service delivery.
  • Experience supporting large ERP systems is required; SAP experience is preferred, and experience across a broader finance systems landscape is beneficial.
  • Strong understanding of support processes, access management, change control, testing, documentation, release management, and finance system controls.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to work across finance, IT, development teams, external partners, and senior stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate complex issues, identify root causes, and drive practical, well-controlled resolutions.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, balance operational support with project delivery, and maintain high-quality outcomes in a fast-paced environment.
In the United States, the base salary for this role ranges from $137,000 to $229,000. In addition to base salary, we offer additional compensation including bonus eligibility and a comprehensive benefits package.  A candidate’s specific pay within this range will depend on a variety of factors, including job-related skills, training, location, experience, relevant education, certifications, and other business and organizational needs.

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Business Operations Coordinator to manage the day-to-day operational execution of the business across CRM management, billing, scheduling, client communication, and administrative workflows.

This is a highly execution-focused role where you’ll ensure operational systems remain accurate, invoices are processed on time, schedules stay organized, and client follow-ups never fall through the cracks. If you’re detail-oriented, systems-driven, and thrive in structured environments, this role is a great fit.

Responsibilities

Operations & Workflow Coordination

  • Maintain daily operational workflows and administrative processes.
  • Support leadership with execution-focused operational tasks.
  • Identify process gaps and improve operational efficiency.
  • Ensure consistent follow-through across business operations.

CRM & Data Management

  • Maintain clean and accurate CRM records.
  • Manage operational data using Excel, Google Sheets, OneDrive, CompanyCam, and CRM platforms.
  • Keep digital records organized and up to date.
  • Ensure data accuracy to support billing and reporting.

Billing & Invoicing

  • Process invoices accurately and on time.
  • Track outstanding payments and follow up on accounts receivable.
  • Coordinate with accounting on reconciliations and supporting documentation.
  • Ensure billing aligns with completed work.

Scheduling & Client Coordination

  • Monitor schedules and workflows using Aspire, Azuga, or similar platforms.
  • Identify scheduling conflicts, job delays, and time discrepancies.
  • Support payroll time tracking and job costing.
  • Manage client communication and ensure timely follow-ups.

Reporting & Administrative Support

  • Prepare reports, proposals, and operational documentation.
  • Conduct vendor and pricing research as needed.
  • Support executive scheduling, email management, and Microsoft Teams communication.

Required Experience & Skills

  • Experience in operations coordination, administrative support, billing, scheduling, or workflow coordination.
  • Strong proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Outlook, Word, Teams, and OneDrive.
  • Experience using CRM systems (Aspire experience is a plus).
  • Strong written communication and organizational skills.
  • High attention to detail and ability to work independently in a remote environment.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Aspire or Azuga.
  • Background in construction, landscaping, field services, or operations-heavy businesses.
  • Experience with payroll coordination, job costing, or accounts receivable.

What Success Looks Like

  • Accurate and organized CRM and operational data.
  • Timely, error-free invoicing and billing.
  • Well-managed schedules with minimal operational conflicts.
  • Consistent client follow-up and communication.
  • Reliable operational execution that leadership can depend on.

Interview Process

  • Initial Recruiter Screening
  • Operations-Focused Interview
  • Practical Workflow or Scenario Assessment
  • Client Interview
  • Offer & Onboarding

What Happens After You Apply

Right after you apply, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record your Intro Video. It’s a short, self-recorded video that completes your application and allows hiring managers to get to know you before the interview process begins.

Rather than repeating your background during multiple screening calls, you’ll tell your story once, allowing future interviews to focus on meaningful conversations.

Don’t overthink it—you can record as many takes as you’d like before submitting. Your invitation will come from Spark Hire, so please check both your inbox and spam folder.

What you’ll bring to the team:

At Forbes Advisor, our mission is to help readers turn their aspirations into reality. We arm people with trusted advice and guidance so they can make informed decisions they feel confident in and get back to doing the things they care about most.

About the Role

Forbes Advisor is hiring a Creative Directorof Paid Social to own end-to-end creative across our Health vertical, a portfolio that today includes weight loss medications, hair loss, hearing, TRT, and dating. You will concept, write, direct, and supervise editorial on the paid social and native creative that drives acquisition for Forbes and its partners, and you will lead a pod of creatives doing the same. This is a direct-response storyteller's role layered with creative management responsibility.

The role reports into the VP Creative and partners with our Paid Social and Native Buyers, who direct the spend, and vertical General Managers, who own category outcomes.

The successful candidate is a senior creative leader. We are a human-led shop that uses AI to accelerate output without diluting craft, and you will be expected tooperatethat way from day one. You can articulate where AI sharpens video storytelling and where it weakens it. In short,AI fluency is a baseline expectation. You already use it to improve the quality and efficiency of your work.

  • Collaborate with editors from pre-production through delivery. Own the cut on hero work, supervise the rest.
  • Analyze performance data and use it to drive incremental and step-change creative optimizations that scale.

  • Provide regular updates on creative performance, hiring, and craft initiatives to the Creative leadership team and to Health vertical stakeholders.
  • Available to travel to locations to film, gather footage, and conduct interviews.

REQUIREMENTS:

  • 10+ years of direct-response creative experience in performance-driven environments (supplements, health, telehealthor comparable), with at least 3 years in a creative management role.
  • Demonstrated experience leading and growing a creative team of 5+ individual contributors across writing, directing, and post.
  • Portfolio of video adswith clear performance attribution. We want to see the actual work and hear the actual results, includingworkyour teamproducedunder your direction.
  • Mastery of direct-response narrative architecture: hook, problem, mechanism, proof, transition, offer, and CTA. Working command of the modern direct-response canon.

  • Comfort working inside compliance rails (FDA-style health claims, regulated health category language, partner brand guardrails).
  • Strong collaboration skills across Creative, Buying,verticalGMs, Editorial, Brand, and Legal.
  • Self-starter with an entrepreneurial mindset, comfortable in a start-up style operating environment.
  • Excellent communication and organizational skills.

STRONG PLUSES:

  • Quiz funnel and branching-narrative video experience.
  • Familiarity with the publisher and native-ad ecosystem (Outbrain, Taboola, sponsored content).
  • Comfort reading performance dashboards (Looker, Tableau, in-platform reporting).
  • Experience building reusable AI workflows for creative production: templates, Claude Projects or custom GPTs, prompt libraries, or agentic tooling that compounds team output without diluting craft.
  • Screenwriting or long-form visual storytelling background.

Parexel is in the business of improving the world’s health. We do this by providing a suite of biopharmaceutical services that help clients across the globe transform scientific discoveries into new treatments. We believe in our values, Patients First, Quality, Respect, Empowerment & Accountability.

This role will work within our innovative Data & Technology group that continues to evolve to meet business needs, fuel Parexel's growth and enable improved support for stakeholders, including customers and ultimately patients, who will benefit from Parexel's integrated processes and systems.

This role can be based in the UK, Serbia, Romania or Poland and can be fully home based in any of those countries.

As the Senior Business Analyst you will work as part of our IT Business Engagement & Enablement department and partner closely with business and technical stakeholders to uncover the true needs of the organization and translate them into clear, actionable, and testable requirements. This role ensures solutions are designed with the end user in mind while meeting enterprise, quality, and regulatory expectations.

In this role you will:

Elicit and define business requirements

  • Identify true business needs using a consulting mindset, distinguishing between “need” and “want.”

  • Gather, analyze, and refine business and functional requirements through stakeholder interviews, workshops, and documentation reviews.

  • Produce clear, complete, and unambiguous requirements documentation, including functional requirements, user stories, process flows, and acceptance criteria.

Maintain traceability and support test coverage

  • Own and maintain requirements traceability matrices (RTMs) to ensure all requirements are fully tested.

  • Partner with QA, Technology Quality Management, and delivery teams to validate requirements, acceptance criteria, and test scenarios.

  • Support the definition of User Acceptance Test (UAT) criteria and scenarios and participate in UAT preparation, dry runs, and execution as needed.

Facilitate workshops and stakeholder alignment

  • Facilitate and co-chair workshops, interviews, and working sessions with cross-functional SMEs and stakeholders.

  • Drive collaborative agreement, prioritization, and decision-making across business and technology teams.

  • Communicate effectively with senior stakeholders, sponsors, and functional leaders to align on scope and outcomes.

Translate business needs to technology delivery

  • Act as the primary translator between business stakeholders and engineering teams, ensuring shared understanding of requirements and solution intent.

  • Serve as the voice of the customer within Scrum or delivery teams when a business SME is not embedded.

  • Assist in identifying technical capabilities and solution approaches that align with desired business outcomes.

  • Partner with UX and Human Factors Engineering (HFE) specialists to ensure requirements support intuitive, user-centered solution design.

Enable continuous improvement ​

  • Apply Business Analysis best practices to continuously improve processes, standards, templates, and ways of working.

  • Identify opportunities to streamline workflows and improve efficiency while maintaining quality and compliance.

  • Contribute to the maturity of Business Analysis practices across initiatives and programs.

You will require the following skills:

  • Strong consulting skills, including root cause analysis and the ability to distinguish between true needs and stated wants.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to translate complex discussions into structured documentation.

  • Proven ability to negotiate, influence, and build consensus with senior stakeholders.

  • Strong requirements documentation and analytical skills.

  • Ability to learn new domains quickly and share knowledge effectively across teams.

  • Ability to work effectively in fast-paced, cross-functional, and globally distributed environments.

  • Comfortable balancing multiple initiatives and priorities simultaneously.

  • Experience with generative AI is preferential, including; requirements drafting and refinement, process analysis and optimisation, workshop acceleration, test case support and backlog grooming assistance.

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in life sciences, computer science, or relevant discipline required.

  • MSc/MBA/advanced degree preferred.

Knowledge and Experience:

  • Advanced level Senior Business Analyst IT experience working in a technical environment within a regulated industry is essential.

  • A strong understanding of clinical trials and previous CRO, Pharma or Biotech industry domain experience is desirable.

  • A solid grounding in Business Analysis best practices and consulting behaviors.

  • Familiarity with Computer System Validation (CSV), SDLC methodologies, and 21 CFR Part 11 concepts.

  • Experience working within regulated environments such as pharmaceutical, biotech, or CRO organizations.

  • Experience supporting project delivery within established Project Lifecycle (PLC) frameworks.

In return we will be able to offer you a structured career pathway and encouragement to develop within the role including awareness and understanding of the industry. You will be well supported and in return for your hard work you will be rewarded with a competitive base salary, holiday as well as other leading benefits you would expect with a top company in the CRO Industry.

Apply today to begin your Parexel journey!

raw.description:
POSITION SUMMARY:

The Principal, Pharmacovigilance / Device Vigilance is a detail-oriented and proactive professional supporting the safety surveillance of In Vitro Diagnostic and Software-driven products across their lifecycle, including clinical studies and post-market activities. This role is responsible for the collection, assessment, reporting, and management of adverse events, product complaints, and safety data for both medicinal products and medical devices, ensuring compliance with global regulatory requirements.

The position plays a critical role in ensuring compliance with global regulatory requirements (e.g., FDA, EU IVDR, Japan) and maintaining the highest standards of patient safety and product quality across both laboratory-developed tests and regulated IVD products, including software/algorithm-based components.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Pharmacovigilance (Drug Safety)

    • Perform case intake, triage, and processing of Individual Case Safety Reports (ICSRs)

    • Process and evaluate adverse events associated with diagnostic use (e.g., clinical impact of false positives/negatives)

    • Coordinate medical review and causality assessment of adverse events

    • Coordinate timely submission of safety reports (e.g., MedWatch, EudraVigilance, CIOMS)

    • Support aggregate reporting (PSUR/PBRER, DSUR, annual reports)

    • Maintain and ensure compliance with global PV regulations (FDA, EMA, ICH, etc.)

    • Contribute to signal detection and risk management activities

  • IVD Device Vigilance

    • Review, triage, and assess product complaints and adverse events related to genetic and diagnostic testing, including incorrect, delayed, or misinterpreted results

    • Evaluate reportability of events under FDA (MDR), EU IVDR vigilance, Japan and other global regulations

    • Prepare and submit Medical Device Reports (MDRs) and vigilance reports within regulatory timelines

    • Collaborate with laboratory operations, bioinformatics, and software teams to investigate root cause (e.g., assay performance, variant interpretation, software defects)

    • Support post-market surveillance activities, including trending, signal detection, and periodic safety reporting

  • Software & Algorithm-Related Safety

    • Assess safety events associated with software as part of a medical device system, including algorithm errors, data processing issues, and reporting inaccuracies

    • Partner with engineering and data science teams to evaluate software-related complaints and implement corrective actions

    • Contribute to risk management activities (e.g., hazard analysis, risk files, FMEA updates) for software and integrated diagnostic systems

  • Cross-Functional & Compliance

    • Ensure compliance with SOPs, GVP, and applicable quality systems (QMS)

    • Partner with Clinical, Regulatory Affairs, Quality, and Medical Affairs teams

    • Support audits and inspections (internal and external)

    • Maintain accurate documentation in safety databases

    • Assist in vendor oversight (e.g., CROs, safety service providers)

    • Other duties as assigned

    • Ability to provide support outside of standard business hours for expedited reporting requirements as needed

​

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Required

    • Bachelor’s degree in life science field (biology, microbiology, chemistry, engineering, medical technology, regulatory science, etc.) or equivalent. Advanced degree in life sciences (MS, PhD, etc.) and/or MBA preferred.

      RAC preferred.

      Minimum of 12 years of direct applicable experience in pharmacovigilance and/or device vigilance

    • Strong knowledge of global safety regulations (FDA, EMA, ICH, EU IVDR, Japan)

    • Experience with safety databases (e.g., AEMS, Argus, ARISg, Veeva Safety)

    • Familiarity with MedDRA coding and case processing workflows

    • Knowledge of applicable standards, including ISO 13485 and ISO 14971

  • Preferred

    • Advanced degree (PharmD, MD, MPH, MSc)

    • Experience in diagnostics or combination products

    • Prior audit/inspection experience

    • RAC, PV certification, or similar credentials

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES:

  • Experience with global markets is highly desirable

  • Strong analytical and clinical assessment skills

  • Attention to detail and regulatory compliance mindset

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines

  • Excellent written and verbal communication

  • Cross-functional collaboration

  • Demonstrated self-starter and highly motivated, energetic and enthusiastic.

  • Ability to exercise independent judgment and discretion within a broadly defined range of policies and practices, which includes analytical problem solving.

  • Demonstrated organizational, planning, and program management skills, including action oriented, focused urgency and driving for results.

  • Ability to be effective in complex projects with ambiguity and/or rapid change

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills including ability to communicate across cultures

  • work with others in a team environment; effective interactions with technical and medical personnel.

  • Computer literacy (PC, Microsoft Office and Google Workspace).

The pay range is listed and actual compensation packages are based on a wide array of factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, years & depth of experience, certifications and specific office location. Sales – Funnel Management Specialist

Company: PMO Strategies

Location: 100% Remote (Working US Hours)

Employment Type: Full-Time (average 40 hours/week), Independent Contractor

Salary: Hourly Rate Aligned with Experience

Help Us Make Sure No Lead Is Left Behind
Are you the kind of person who notices when something falls through the cracks—and makes sure it *never* happens again? Do you love organizing systems, following up on details, and making sure the right messages get to the right people at the right time?
If you're nodding your head, we want to talk to you.
Join our fast-growing US-based training and consulting company and help us ensure that every potential customer has a seamless, professional, and engaging experience—from the first click to a closed sale and beyond.

About PMO Strategies
At PMO Strategies, our mission is to change the world through IMPACT. We help organizations deliver more business value, faster, through smarter strategy execution.
We support project and transformation leaders with training, coaching, and consulting that helps them drive measurable results. Our clients include some of the world’s most forward-thinking organizations—and we’re growing fast.
Learn more:
PMOStrategies.com
IMPACTEngineBook.com

Position Overview

We’re seeking a Sales – Funnel Management Specialist to own, manage, and continuously improve our lead and sales funnel operations using Zoho CRM, ClickFunnels, and related tools.

This is not a cold-calling sales role.
It is a role that sits at the intersection of systems, sales support, and relationship-centered communication.

You’ll be the first line of coordination when a new lead enters our ecosystem—whether through a form, funnel opt-in, webinar, survey, or direct inquiry. Your responsibility is to ensure every lead is:

  • Routed correctly
  • Followed up thoughtfully
  • Tracked accurately
  • Supported with the right message at the right time

This role is ideal for someone who thrives on structure, loves CRM systems, and understands that real sales success depends on human connection—not just automation.

Key Responsibilities

Lead & Funnel Management

  • Monitor all incoming leads via Zoho CRM, ClickFunnels, website forms, surveys, webinars, and direct inquiries.
  • Assign leads to the appropriate team member (sales, success coach, or automation workflow) based on defined criteria.
  • Ensure timely, accurate follow-up so no opportunity is missed.
  • Track lead status across the funnel and conduct regular audits to prevent lead leakage.
  • Maintain clean, accurate CRM data including tagging, lifecycle stages, and attribution.

Automation & CRM Operations

  • Build, maintain, and optimize automations using Zoho Campaigns, ClickFunnels, and Zapier.
  • Implement tagging structures to track campaign source, behavior, and funnel entry points.
  • Test and troubleshoot workflows regularly to ensure smooth transitions between funnel stages.
  • Maintain SOPs for lead handling, hand-offs, and system workflows.

Sales Support & Coordination

  • Maintain real-time visibility into deal and lead progression within the CRM.
  • Manage lead hand-off protocols to ensure warm leads are followed up within defined timeframes.
  • Coordinate closely with sales, marketing, partnerships, and operations teams to support high-conversion campaigns.
  • Support upsell and post-purchase nurture workflows to extend customer lifetime value.

Reporting & Funnel Optimization

  • Provide regular reporting on lead activity, conversion rates, velocity, and drop-off points.
  • Build dashboards and performance snapshots in Zoho CRM.
  • Identify friction points and recommend improvements to funnels, sequences, or hand-offs.
  • Monitor opt-in rates, email engagement, and CTA performance across funnels.

Relationship-Centered Lead Communication & Sales Support

This role carries a clear human expectation, not just a technical one.

You are expected to:
  • Treat every lead as a real person with unique goals, challenges, and motivations—not just a CRM record.
  • Craft thoughtful, context-aware written correspondence (emails, follow-ups, responses) that reflects our brand voice and builds trust.
  • Adapt tone, message, and timing based on lead behavior, stated needs, objections, and engagement signals.
  • Communicate directly with leads when appropriate to clarify needs, answer questions, or guide next steps—supporting sales conversations rather than disappearing behind automation.
  • Ensure the right message reaches the right person at the right moment, balancing high-touch communication with scalable systems.

This role succeeds when automation supports relationships—not replaces them.

Qualifications
  • Minimum of 3+ years in CRM, sales coordination, or funnel management roles.
  • Deep familiarity with CRM management and related tools (Zoho Campaigns, Forms, etc.).
  • Experience using ClickFunnels, Zapier, and other funnel or automation tools.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to write clear, human, sales-supportive messaging.
  • Highly tech-savvy and confident managing data, automations, and process flows.
  • Ability to work full-time during U.S. business hours (Eastern or Central Time).
  • Prior experience in a digital marketing, consulting, or online education environment is a plus.

Why Join PMO Strategies?
  • Be part of a passionate, high-performing team on a global mission.
  • Work from anywhere with a flexible schedule.
  • Gain direct access to visionary leadership and professional growth opportunities.
  • Help ensure high-value prospects are nurtured and never missed—making a real IMPACT.

How to Apply
Are you the follow-up champion we’ve been looking for?
Submit your resume, cover letter, and any examples of lead management experience (such as dashboards or SOPs you've created) in this app with the subject line I’m Your Sales Funnel Management Pro.

raw.description:
About ScholarshipOwl

ScholarshipOwl is the largest scholarship marketplace in the U.S., connecting over 14 million Gen Z students with private scholarships — and the brands that power them. Our mission is to make education financing more accessible and engaging, while giving brands a way to connect with the next generation.

We’re powered by AI technology that simplifies scholarship discovery, streamlines the application process, and delivers measurable results for both students and partners. Whether it’s helping students secure funding or enabling brands to run impactful campaigns, we’re reshaping how education is funded — and discovered.

The Role

We’re looking for a Growth Product Manager to take full ownership of the conversion engine at ScholarshipOwl, from the first visitor touchpoint through to a paid subscription. This is a high-impact, high-velocity role for someone who lives in the data, thrives on experimentation, and values action over perfection.

You will be the architect of our growth. You’ll spend your days identifying leaks in the funnel, hypothesizing solutions, and working alongside a dedicated pod of engineers and designers to ship experiments that move the needle on revenue and retention. If you are a "full-stack" growth thinker who can move from a Mixpanel cohort analysis to a detailed technical spec this is the role for you.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the Conversion Engine: Take end-to-end responsibility for the user journey, optimizing every step from landing page registration to paywall conversion and subscription retention.

  • Drive the Experiment Roadmap: Build, prioritize, and maintain a high-tempo experimentation backlog. You will use frameworks (like ICE or RICE) to ensure we are always working on the highest-leverage growth bets.

  • Analyze & Diagnose: Monitor funnel and retention metrics daily in Mixpanel. You’ll identify exactly where users are dropping off and perform deep-dive discovery to understand the why.

  • Ship with Velocity: Write precise product specs and acceptance criteria that allow engineering and design to execute independently. We prioritize shipping "good enough" tests today to get data, rather than waiting for "perfect" features next month.

  • Optimize Revenue Levers: Design and run pricing, paywall, and offer optimization tests. You’ll also evaluate new growth levers like organic loops, landing page personalization, and winback programs.

  • Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Lead a dedicated pod of engineers and designers, maintaining strong working relationships with our dashboard and B2B teams to drive unified sprint priorities.

  • Continuous Discovery: Conduct meaningful customer discovery interviews with our Gen-Z audience to uncover behavioral insights that data alone can’t show.

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of Product Management experience, specifically in a Growth-focused role.

  • Experimentation Mastery: Proven track record of designing, running, and analyzing A/B tests that resulted in measurable improvements to business KPIs (CVR, ARPU, Churn).

  • Data Fluency: You are a power user of product analytics tools (Mixpanel, Amplitude, or similar). You don't wait for a data analyst; you find the answers yourself.

  • SaaS/Subscription Expertise: You understand the nuances of subscription models—trial-to-paid transitions, renewal cycles, and friction-point reduction.

  • Technical Precision: Ability to write clear, "dev-ready" product specs and acceptance criteria. You understand technical trade-offs and how to scope an MVP.

  • Mentoring & Leadership: A mentoring and knowledge-sharing mindset with a desire to level up the broader team on growth methodologies and experimentation rigor.

  • Gen-Z Empathy: You have an intuition for (or experience with) B2C products targeting younger audiences and understand their unique digital behaviors.

  • Growth Mindset: You are comfortable with ambiguity, fast-moving environments, and the fact that 70% of experiments might fail—as long as we learn from them.

Bonus Points:

  • Experience with payment platforms (Stripe, Braintree) or Figma/prototyping tools.

  • Knowledge of lifecycle/email marketing, SEO, and paid acquisition channels.

  • Growth-focused certifications (e.g., Reforge).

  • Background in EdTech or student-facing products.

Why Join ScholarshipOwl?

  • Mission-Driven Work – Build technology that helps students unlock education opportunities.

  • Fully Remote – Work from anywhere while collaborating with a global team.

  • High Impact & Ownership – You aren't just a cog in a machine; you own the revenue engine.

  • Unlimited PTO – We value results over hours worked and trust you to manage your time.

  • Coworking Budget – $200/month to rent a coworking space.

  • Hardware Budget – Up to $1,600 to invest in your ideal computer.

  • Continuous Learning Culture – We support curiosity, experimentation, and growth.

  • Annual Company Off-sites – Connect with your teammates in person at various locations around the globe.

Ready to move the needle? Apply now and show us how you’d build the future of student growth.

Highlights

We’re looking for a Growth Product Manager to take full ownership of the conversion engine at ScholarshipOwl, from the first visitor touchpoint through to a paid subscription.

Job Description

We are seeking a full-time or volunteer professional Project Manager to help us coordinate the work of distributed teams of dynamic software developers and field trial users of our products. We have product teams that work in various frameworks and platforms and field users in every corner of the globe.

The Project Manager is a holistic, mid-level leadership role for larger teams with responsibilities that encompass a scope of product evaluation and field trials extending throughout the entire product lifecycle. This role includes project schedule management and communication, dependency coordination, financial management, and extends to communication of details of progress to external funders and co-development partners. Project Managers work closely with the Development team, Language Technology leadership, partners, and supporting organizations, user communities, and leaders of field trials. A good Project Manager is expected to be a customer/stakeholder spokesperson, process expert for product development, team champion, and a strategic thinker. The goal of this role is to help Align the technology roadmaps and sprint priorities with the language program roadmap to ensure that all dependencies are addressed and accounted for. Forbes Advisor boasts decades of experience across dozens of geographies and teams, including Content, SEO, Business Intelligence, Finance, HR, Marketing, Production, Technology and Sales. The team brings rich industry knowledge to Forbes Advisor's global coverage of consumer credit, debt, health, home improvement, banking, investing, credit cards, small business, education, insurance, loans, real estate and travel.

Role Overview:

We're looking for a senior small business expert to lead how we define, collect and assess data within Forbes Advisor's SMB vertical. As Head of Methodology & Data, SMB, you'll own the strategic vision and execution for Forbes Advisor's SMB methodologies and data products spanning business formation, accounting, payroll, payments, communications, HR and business operations software.

You'll work cross-functionally to turn complex business products, operational workflows, regulations and customer needs into clear, defensible scoring frameworks and structured datasets.

This is a hands-on strategy and leadership role: part SME, part architect of how our SMB rankings and data products work and evolve.

Responsibilities:

  • Own SMB methodology strategy across formation, banking, accounting, payroll, payments, communications, HR, lending and business operations software.
  • Define clear, defensible evaluation frameworks that reflect SMB user needs, market realities and update cadence.
  • Shape proprietary SMB metrics and structured datasets for rankings, editorial use and potential data products.
  • Define research and data collection requirements; partner with testing, data and research teams to ensure evidence quality.
  • Establish quality standards for SMB methodologies, scoring models, documentation and analyst work.
  • Mentor analysts and serve as the internal SME for SMB market dynamics, methodology design, and data quality.
  • Partner with editorial, SEO, product, commercial, testing and data teams to translate methodology into credible rankings and scalable data products.

Must-Have

  • 5+ years of experience in SMB products, services, SaaS, fintech, operations, consulting, analytics, product management or related fields.
  • Deep understanding of how small businesses evaluate, buy and use products or services to start, operate and grow.
  • Experience building or overseeing analytical frameworks, rating systems, benchmarking programs, structured evaluations or data products.
  • Strong ability to translate complex business, financial, operational or technical concepts into clear guidance for non-experts.
  • Proven ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders and guide work across editorial, product, commercial, analytics, research or testing teams.

Nice-to-Have

  • Experience at a review site, marketplace, ratings organization, fintech, SaaS provider, business services company or SMB data provider.

JOB DETAILS

Job Title: Tour Operations Coordinator

Location: Remote

Reports To: Offshore Project Manager

Work Shift: Flexible, with overlap during US business hours preferred

Working Hours: Part-Time ( with potential to increase depending on tour schedule)

Job Description

We are seeking a highly organized Tour Operations Coordinator to support the planning, coordination, and day-to-day administration of live events and touring operations across multiple locations.

This role is responsible for maintaining tour schedules, coordinating logistics, supporting MasterTour administration, organizing travel and venue documentation, and ensuring all operational details are completed accurately before each event.

The ideal candidate combines exceptional organizational skills with strong operational discipline and enjoys coordinating multiple moving pieces simultaneously.

Success in this role requires someone who can proactively manage logistics, maintain accurate documentation, communicate effectively with internal and external stakeholders, and ensure tours operate smoothly with minimal oversight.

This is not an Executive Assistant role. The primary focus is operational coordination and administrative execution for touring, events, and related business operations.

Key Responsibilities

Tour Operations

  • Coordinate day-to-day operational activities for live tours and events

  • Maintain tour schedules, timelines, and operational checklists

  • Ensure all pre-event requirements are completed on time

  • Monitor tour readiness across multiple locations

  • Track outstanding action items and follow up with internal stakeholders

MasterTour Administration

  • Maintain accurate information within MasterTour

  • Update tour schedules, venue information, and event details

  • Ensure operational records remain current and organized

  • Support reporting and documentation related to tour operations

Travel & Logistics Coordination

  • Coordinate flights, accommodations, ground transportation, and travel itineraries

  • Maintain travel documentation and schedules

  • Coordinate logistics with venues, vendors, and internal team members

  • Track travel changes and communicate updates promptly

Administrative Support

  • Organize operational documentation, contracts, and event files

  • Maintain shared drives and operational resources

  • Prepare operational summaries and status reports

  • Support recurring administrative projects as assigned

Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Collaborate with marketing, finance, customer support, and operations teams to ensure event readiness

  • Coordinate information between departments

  • Escalate operational risks and scheduling conflicts proactively

  • Support process improvements across tour operations

Qualifications

Required

  • 3+ years of experience in operations coordination, administrative coordination, event operations, or project coordination

  • Experience coordinating schedules, logistics, or multi-step operational projects

  • Strong organizational and time management skills

  • Experience using project management platforms such as ClickUp, Asana, Monday.com, or similar

  • Strong attention to detail and documentation skills

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills

  • Experience coordinating with multiple internal and external stakeholders

  • Experience coordinating travel and accommodation logistics

  • Experience supporting fast-paced founder-led businesses

  • Ability to manage multiple deadlines simultaneously

  • Strong problem-solving skills with a proactive mindset

  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision

Preferred

  • Experience supporting live events, touring, hospitality, or venue operations

  • Experience using MasterTour or similar event management software

  • Experience using AI tools to improve administrative and operational workflows

Summary

Are you passionate about positively changing the lives of others? California Institute of Applied Technology (CIAT) is growing and seeking educators and professionals with a passion for mentoring others. If this is you, please contact us! CIAT prepares students for professional success by offering practical training in today’s most competitive technology fields to make sure students are job-ready. With a large selection of courses, flexible schedules, and an online campus, we aim to empower the working student. We are laser-focused on student success, whether just starting out, making a career change, or transitioning into civilian life, CIAT prepares students for success!


Teaching:

  • Available to teach synchronous online courses via Microsoft Teams on Monday and Tuesday every week
  • Plan and organize instruction in ways that maximize student learning and engagement
  • Modify, where appropriate, instructional methods and strategies to meet diverse student’s needs
  • Employ appropriate teaching and learning strategies to communicate subject matter to students via a synchronous online format (Microsoft Teams)
  • Current certifications in subjects taught

Mastery of Subject Matter:

  • Demonstrate a thorough and accurate knowledge of their field or discipline
  • Connect their subject matter with related fields
  • Stay current in their subject matter through professional development, through involvement in professional organizations, and attending professional meetings, conferences, or workshops

Adhering to College Policies and Procedures:

Requirements

  • Certifications we are looking for: CompTIA Security+ ($35-$48/hourly), CISSP: Certified Information Systems Security Professional ($40-$48/hourly), CEH: EC-Council Certified Ethical Hacker ($38-$48/hourly), CGRC: Governance, Risk and Compliance ($38-$48/hourly), CompTIA CySA+ ($38-$48/hourly) , CompTIA PenTest+ ($38-$48/hourly), CompTIA SecAI+ ($43-$45/hourly)
  • At least three years’ experience in the respective field of Cyber, Network and Information Security OR two years of teaching experience
  • At least three years’ experience in the respective field OR two years of teaching experience
  • Synchronous online teaching experience preferred
  • Advanced subject matter expertise preferred with a commitment to ongoing professional development and staying current with developments in the field
  • Effective presentation skills, communication and technology skills
  • Good working knowledge of MS Office applications including Microsoft Teams, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint as well as learning technologies such as Canvas
  • Work independently with minimal supervision, with a high level of dependability
  • Ability to multitask

  • Ability to work collaboratively with colleagues, academic departments, and administration to support student success, achieve institutional goals and contribute to a positive and inclusive culture
  • Commitment to fostering an inclusive and supportive learning environment that respects the diversity of students' backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives
  • Knowledge of current trends, best practices, and didactic approaches in higher education
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver engaging and effective lesson plans that meet the diverse needs of students
  • Strong communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to effectively convey information and interact with students, colleagues, and others

  • Compliance with all college policies, procedures, and regulations, including those related to academic integrity, student conduct, and instructional delivery
  • Must be able to embody CIAT’s mission, vision and values

Position Type and Expected Hours of Work

Days and hours of work are usually Monday through Friday, but weekend and evening hours may be required. Live classes are scheduled twice per week on Monday and Tuesday, from 6:00 pm to 9:30 pm (Pacific Time).


Supervisory Responsibility

This position has no supervisory responsibilities.


Values

Values such as integrity, excellence, customer service, teamwork and mutual respect are some of those that remain constant, regardless of changes in our company. When identifying company values, it is important that those values are being demonstrated in the course of business each day. Our values set expectations for how employees and managers interact with every person while representing the company.

  • We are passionate about education and student success
  • We value integrity and excellence in our employees and students
  • We treat ourselves and our students with dignity and respect
  • We believe in and encourage innovation at our school to better help our students succeed
  • We have a customer centric focus and we want people highly committed to achieving goals, where our success equals student’s success
  • We are accountable for our actions and focus on improvements moving forward
  • We have a growth mindset with a sincere belief that every student can do better and achieve their goals
  • We expect every employee to be an example of conduct and professionalism, being a role model to students and colleagues
  • We commit to fostering an inclusive and supportive learning environment that respects the diversity of students' backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives

Physical Demands

Field Marketing Manager

Location: Remote or Hybrid (U.S.)

Why Join Omnicell?

At Omnicell, we're transforming the future of pharmacy and healthcare operations through innovative technology, data-driven insights, and meaningful customer partnerships. As a Field Marketing Manager, you'll play a pivotal role in bringing our go-to-market strategy to life, working at the intersection of Marketing and Sales to create exceptional customer experiences that drive business impact.

This is an exciting opportunity to partner with cross-functional teams, influence pipeline growth, and execute high-visibility programs that directly support customer engagement and revenue outcomes. If you're energized by creating memorable experiences, collaborating with Sales leaders, and turning strategic campaigns into measurable results, we'd love to hear from you.

What You'll Do

Purpose

Drive regional and segment-focused marketing programs that accelerate pipeline growth, strengthen customer relationships, and support Omnicell's go-to-market priorities.

As a Field Marketing Manager, you will:

Primary Impact

Serve as a strategic partner to Sales by translating enterprise marketing strategies into localized programs that increase customer engagement, generate pipeline, and contribute to revenue growth.

Field Marketing Program Execution

  • Execute regional and segment-specific marketing programs aligned with Sales priorities, target accounts, and strategic GTM initiatives.
  • Activate integrated campaigns through tradeshows, conferences, executive events, roundtables, roadshows, and regional customer programs.
  • Ensure all programs align with target audiences, campaign objectives, solution messaging, and customer use cases.
  • Deliver high-quality experiences that reinforce Omnicell's brand and customer value proposition.

Sales Alignment & Account Engagement

  • Partner closely with Sales leaders and account teams to understand territory priorities, pipeline objectives, and strategic opportunities.
  • Align marketing programs to account-based engagement strategies and deal progression goals.
  • Support Sales with targeted activations, hosted events, executive engagement opportunities, and customer-focused experiences.
  • Coordinate post-event follow-up activities to maximize engagement and pipeline impact.

Campaign Activation & Go-to-Market Integration

  • Execute enterprise marketing campaigns at the field level while maintaining message consistency and brand standards.
  • Collaborate with Product Marketing, Demand Generation, Marketing Operations, and Content teams to bring integrated campaigns to market.
  • Incorporate digital, content, event, and experiential tactics to create seamless customer journeys.
  • Ensure field programs reinforce Omnicell's key value propositions and solution positioning.

Event & Experience Leadership

  • Lead the execution of executive briefings, customer events, hosted dinners, conferences, trade shows, and regional marketing programs.
  • Collaborate with Event Operations and cross-functional stakeholders to deliver exceptional customer and prospect experiences.
  • Showcase Omnicell's commitment to improving clinical, operational, and business outcomes for healthcare organizations.

Pipeline Contribution & Performance Optimization

  • Drive event-sourced and event-influenced pipeline through effective planning and execution.
  • Track and analyze program performance, including attendance, engagement, sales participation, and pipeline contribution.
  • Partner with Marketing Operations to ensure accurate lead capture, measurement, and reporting.
  • Leverage performance data and stakeholder feedback to continually improve future programs.

Customer Advocacy & Experience

  • Partner with Client Engagement teams to incorporate customer advocates, references, site visits, and success stories into field programs.
  • Create customer-centric experiences that build trust, strengthen relationships, and support long-term growth.
  • Capture customer insights and feedback to inform future marketing strategies and engagement approaches.

Operational Excellence

  • Coordinate event logistics including registration, attendee communications, agendas, speaker management, shipping, audiovisual requirements, and onsite execution.
  • Manage vendors, timelines, deliverables, and budget adherence to ensure successful program outcomes.
  • Maintain operational rigor and execution excellence across multiple concurrent initiatives.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner closely with Field Marketing leadership, Product Marketing, Marketing Operations, Event Operations, Demand Generation, Corporate Marketing, and Sales teams.
  • Act as a connector across functions to ensure strategic alignment, clear communication, and successful program execution.

Who You Are

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in marketing, business, communications, or related field
  • 3+ years of experience in field marketing, event marketing, or demand generation
  • Proven experience executing marketing programs tied to pipeline and sales outcomes
  • Strong project management and organizational skills
  • Ability to partner effectively with Sales and cross-functional stakeholders
  • Strong communication and coordination skills in fast-paced environments

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Experience in healthcare technology, healthcare services, enterprise software, or other B2B environments.
  • Experience supporting tradeshows, executive events, customer programs, and account-focused marketing initiatives.
  • Familiarity with CRM platforms, marketing automation systems, and reporting tools.
  • Understanding of account-based marketing (ABM), integrated campaign strategies, and modern go-to-market models.
  • Experience working within matrixed organizations and cross-functional teams.

How You'll Elevate at Omnicell

At Omnicell, success isn't just about what you achieve. It's about how you achieve it. As a Field Marketing Manager, you will demonstrate our Elevate Behaviors every day

Collaborate

  • Build strong partnerships across Sales, Product Marketing, Marketing Operations, Event Operations, and Customer Engagement teams to deliver unified customer experiences and business results.

Inspire

  • Influence stakeholders and foster alignment around field marketing initiatives that create meaningful customer engagement and pipeline impact.

Develop

  • Continuously learn from customer insights, campaign results, and market trends while sharing knowledge and best practices with colleagues and partners.

Execute

  • Take ownership of multiple programs simultaneously, establish priorities, and consistently deliver high-quality results on time and within budget.

Impact

Drive measurable business outcomes by connecting marketing investments to pipeline growth, customer engagement, and revenue contribution. Challenge conventional approaches and identify innovative opportunities to improve program performance

Work Conditions

  • Remote or hybrid work environment.
  • Up to 40% travel for customer engagements, industry events, sales meetings, and team collaboration sessions.

About us

Coalition is the world's first Active Insurance provider designed to help prevent digital risk before it strikes. Founded in 2017, Coalition combines comprehensive insurance coverage and innovative cybersecurity tools to help businesses manage and mitigate potential cyberattacks.

Opportunities to make an impact with bold thinking are real—and happening daily at Coalition.

About the role

The Claims team at Coalition stands apart for our outstanding level of consumer service and knowledgeable handling of claims for our insured customers. As a team, Claims is about finding ways to help our consumers find a solution to cyber risk. As we continue to expand, we are seeking an experienced claims professional to join our cyber claims team and lend a hand in handling intricate primary Cyber, Tech, and Media policies. You will also provide assistance to the underwriting team and manage/collaborate with a variety of vendors such as breach coaches, defense counsel, and coverage counsel for Coalition and its partner carriers.

This is a remote opportunity that can be based anywhere in the United Kingdom.

  • Handle litigation including 3rd party liability arising from security failure or data breaches, Media and Tech E&O

About Us

Ada is an AI customer service company whose mission is to make customer service extraordinary for everyone. Ada is an AI transformation platform and partner—combining strategic expertise with powerful AI agent management technology to accelerate businesses’ AI maturity to keep them ahead of the curve. With Ada, 83% of customer conversations—and counting—are effortlessly resolved through automation, giving teams more time back, companies more resources to focus on growth, and customers more life to focus on what matters most to them.

Established in 2016, Ada is a Canadian company that has powered over 5.5 billion interactions for leading brands like Square, YETI, IPSY, and , saving millions of hours of human effort. Backed with over $250M in funding from tier-one investors including Accel, Bessemer, FirstMark, Spark, and Version One Ventures, Ada is a pioneer in the management and application of AI in customer service.

At Ada, we see growth as a reflection of each individual owner’s personal growth. That’s why our values are rooted in driving progress and continuous improvement. If you’re ambitious and eager to grow, Ada could be the place for you.

Learn more at .

Security at Ada

Ada's AI Agent resolves customer service conversations for enterprises — which means our customers trust us with their customers' data and their brand. Security and compliance are how we earn and keep that trust. The Security team partners across engineering, legal, and go-to-market to make sure Ada's controls are real, evidenced, and easy for customers to verify.

Our Role

As Compliance & Security Lead, you own Ada's security compliance program end to end: audits, customer trust, vendor risk, vulnerability management, and the control framework that ties it all together. Our audit season runs August through November — your mandate is to automate evidence collection and process to the point where the team is audit-ready year-round, not scrambling seasonally. You are the internal source of truth on compliance status and the external face of Ada's security posture: you will own security conversations with enterprise prospects and customers. As agentic AI regulation takes shape (starting with AIUC), you translate framework movement into concrete requirements for the platform team.

About You

  • Deep audit experience across SOC 1, SOC 2, PCI DSS, NIST frameworks, AICPA standards, and PII/privacy requirements. You have run audits end to end: evidence collection, control mapping, and auditor coordination.
  • Experience working directly with major audit firms such as Deloitte or EY; you know what a gold-standard audit engagement looks like from the inside.
  • You have inherited manual compliance programs and driven them toward automation tooling, process, and repeatability (Drata or similar compliance automation platforms).
  • Vulnerability management at scale: you have taken a large vulnerability backlog (thousands of findings) and driven it down through prioritization, ownership, and process.
  • Customer-facing confidence: you own the room in security posture conversations with enterprise prospects, and you are equally comfortable saying "let me get back to you" and then actually getting back to them.
  • An engineering background is preferred but not required; you must understand modern infrastructure, Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD! well enough to hold your own with engineers and auditors alike.
  • Experienced owner of RFP security sections, customer security questionnaires, and trust centers (SafeBase or similar).
  • Strong writer: policies, control documentation, and data handling standards that people actually follow.
  • Proactive owner who builds programs that outlast you: process, documentation, and tooling over heroics.
  • You track regulatory and framework movement interest in agentic AI governance (AIUC and emerging frameworks) is a strong plus.

Outcomes

  • Own Ada's security audits end to end: the upcoming AIUC audit, PCI, and SOC 2. Evidence collection, control mapping, and auditor coordination, run through Drata.
  • Automate evidence collection and control monitoring so that audit season (August–November) no longer requires heroics the team is audit-ready year-round.
  • Own the security and compliance sections of customer RFPs and security questionnaires. Maintain the SafeBase trust center so deals stop stalling on security review.
  • Own vulnerability management as a program: drive the backlog down with clear prioritization, ownership, and SLAs for critical findings.
  • Run vendor security and privacy reviews as a standing process with clear SLAs, not one-off scrambles.
  • Maintain the control framework and its documentation: policies, data handling, retention, and the evidence that controls actually operate.
  • Be the point of contact for customer security, privacy, and legal teams, and the internal source of truth on compliance status.
  • Track regulatory and framework movement relevant to agentic AI, starting with AIUC, and translate it into concrete internal requirements for the platform team.
  • Take ownership of the compliance work currently spread across the team, and make it sustainable.
  • First 90 days: take full ownership of the AIUC audit, produce a current-state gap assessment against our target frameworks, and turn the RFP security response into a repeatable process.

Benefits & Perks

At Ada, you’ll not only build extraordinary products but also thrive in an environment designed for your success. We prioritize your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Here’s what we offer:

Benefits

  • Unlimited Vacation: Recharge when you need to.
  • Comprehensive Benefits: Extended health coverage, dental, vision, travel, and life insurance.
  • Wellness Account: Empowering you to invest in your overall well-being and lifestyle.
  • Employee & Family Assistance Plan: Resources to support you and your loved ones.

Perks

  • Flexible Work Schedule: Balance your work and personal life.
  • Remote-First, In-Person Friendly: Options to work from home or at our local hub.
  • Learning & Development Budget: Invest in your long-term growth goals and skills.
  • Work from Home Budget: Equipping you with the tools and support for a seamless remote work experience.
  • Access to Cutting-Edge AI Tools: Work with the best AI tech stack in the industry.
  • Hands-On with LLMs: Enhance your expertise in leveraging large language models.
  • A Thriving Industry: Join the forefront of innovation in AI, shaping the future of technology.

The above Benefits and Perks only apply to full-time, permanent employees.

As part of our recruitment process, we may use AI enabled tools to support certain aspects of hiring, such as interview note-taking. All hiring decisions are made by our team.

Thank you for your interest in joining us at Ada. Due to the high volume of applications, we will only contact candidates whose qualifications match closely to the requirements of the position. We appreciate the time you have invested in learning more about us.

CapsLock is a dynamic marketing company providing IT-enabled solutions for large North American partners. We specialize in scalable customer acquisition through data-driven marketing, creative production, and technology innovation.

Our teams collaborate across Marketing, IT, Analytics, CRO, and Media Buying to build, test, and optimize high-performing funnels that help clients achieve predictable growth across industries such as Home Improvement, Health, Legal, and Insurance.

Role Overview

We're looking for a Senior Marketing Strategist who thinks like a strategist, creative person and optimizer—someone who understands customer behavior, identifies growth opportunities, and continuously improves marketing performance through experimentation.

You'll be responsible for developing new funnels, conducting market and competitor research, generating hypotheses, managing A/B testing initiatives, and collaborating closely with Creative, Media Buying, Analytics, and IT teams to deliver measurable business results.

Success in this role means constantly asking "How can we improve conversion?" and using data to find the answer.

Responsibilities

  • Conduct market, audience, and competitor research for new and existing clients.
  • Develop new landing page concepts and marketing funnels.
  • Generate, prioritize, and document CRO hypotheses.
  • Plan and manage A/B testing roadmaps across multiple clients.
  • Analyze landing page performance and identify optimization opportunities.
  • Collaborate with Copywriters, Designers, Video Producers, IT, and Media Buyers throughout the production process.
  • Review campaign performance and translate data into actionable insights.
  • Identify winning strategies and scale them across similar clients and industries.
  • Maintain and expand the company's CRO knowledge base and testing library.
  • Research new marketing trends, technologies, and customer acquisition strategies.
  • Ensure projects are delivered on time and meet quality standards.
  • Present recommendations and optimization plans to internal stakeholders.

AI & Experimentation Mindset

You actively use AI to improve research, productivity, and decision-making. Whether it's generating hypotheses, analyzing competitors, organizing knowledge, or accelerating content creation, you view AI as a strategic assistant rather than a replacement for marketing thinking.

We're looking for someone who enjoys experimenting, learning, and continuously improving existing processes.

Requirements

Essential

  • 5+ years of experience in Performance Marketing, CRO, Digital Marketing, or Growth Marketing.
  • Strong understanding of customer acquisition funnels and landing page optimization.
  • Experience planning and evaluating A/B tests.
  • Ability to interpret marketing data and make data-driven decisions.
  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams.
  • Excellent project management and organizational skills.
  • Exceptional communication skills.
  • Proficient English language skills.
  • Experience with AI tools for marketing research and automation.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in Home Improvement or Lead Generation industries.
  • Experience working with Meta, Google Ads, Native Advertising, or YouTube.
  • Knowledge of UX principles and conversion optimization.
  • Familiarity with Tableau, GA4, Microsoft Clarity, Hotjar, or similar analytics tools.

﻿Why do we deserve your attention?

Not only do we offer fair and competitive pay, but we also provide perks and benefits that support your well-being and growth. Here are some of them:

Remote Work

We are a truly remote-first company. You choose where you feel the most productive and comfortable to make an impact.

Paid Time Off

Work-life balance matters to us, and we support it with paid time off for rest, personal time, or simply doing what makes you happy.

Ongoing Learning

We believe in curiosity and growth. That’s why we support continuous learning with workshops, online courses, conferences, and certifications.

Home Office

We help you set up your perfect workspace by covering equipment and furniture expenses, so you can do your best work from home.

Physical Well-Being

From gym memberships and yoga classes to home workout equipment or even a bicycle, we give you the flexibility to stay active your way.

Unlimited Sick Days

Your health matters. Take the time you need to rest and recover - we’ll be here when you’re ready to return.

Medical Coverage

We support you and your family with reimbursement for medical insurance and health-related expenses, including dental care and psychological support.

Co-Working Space

If you sometimes crave a change of scenery or more social interaction, we’ll cover the full cost of a co-working space.

Fun Stuff

From gaming nights and fitness challenges to annual retreats at world-class resorts, we make sure there’s never a shortage of fun and connection.

raw.description:
As part of SIDE’s Global Player Support organisation, you will manage the Zendesk environment supporting a multilingual, global player support operation.

This is a hands-on role covering platform administration, workflow design, Help Center development, reporting, integrations, and continuous improvement. You will work with Operations, Quality, Training, Reporting, Technology, and client stakeholders to turn business requirements into practical and scalable Zendesk solutions.

You will be responsible for keeping the platform stable, secure, and well governed while improving agent productivity, player experience, self-service, and operational visibility.

Requirements

What You’ll Be Doing

Zendesk Administration and Workflow Management

  • Administer and maintain ticket forms, custom fields, views, macros, triggers, automations, routing rules, business rules, SLAs, groups, organizations, and user roles.
  • Manage user onboarding, offboarding, permissions, and access controls in line with security requirements.
  • Design and improve workflows that support efficient ticket handling and reduce unnecessary manual effort.
  • Ensure platform configurations remain scalable, documented, and aligned with approved operational requirements.

Help Center and Self-Service

  • Design, customize, and maintain Zendesk Guide and player-facing Help Center experiences.
  • Develop responsive Help Center themes using HTML, Handlebars, CSS/SCSS, JavaScript, and JSON.
  • Improve navigation, ticket-entry points, and self-service journeys while maintaining client branding and accessibility standards.
  • Test and validate Help Center and front-end changes before deployment.

Reporting and Integrations

  • Partner with the Reporting team to build and maintain Zendesk Explore dashboards covering SLAs, productivity, customer satisfaction, backlog, quality, and other operational KPIs.
  • Maintain fields and data-capture processes that support accurate and consistent reporting.
  • Manage integrations between Zendesk, Jira, and other approved systems, including ticket escalation, field mapping, status synchronization, and communication workflows.
  • Investigate and resolve reporting, integration, data-sync, and workflow issues affecting support operations.

Change Management and Continuous Improvement

  • Assess the risks, dependencies, and downstream impact of proposed platform changes.
  • Coordinate testing, documentation, communication, and controlled deployment of approved enhancements.
  • Review the wider Zendesk ecosystem—including workflows, reporting, automation, integrations, knowledge management, and self-service—to identify inefficiencies and service gaps.
  • Develop and present a prioritized improvement roadmap outlining recommendations, expected outcomes, implementation approaches, and success measures.

What You’ll Bring

  • Two to five years of experience administering Zendesk Support in a production environment.
  • Practical experience configuring forms, fields, triggers, automations, macros, views, routing logic, business rules, and SLAs.
  • Experience maintaining Zendesk Guide themes using HTML, CSS/SCSS, JavaScript, Handlebars, and JSON.
  • Experience building or supporting operational dashboards and reports using Zendesk Explore.
  • Experience maintaining Zendesk–Jira integrations and troubleshooting platform, workflow, or data-synchronization issues.
  • Experience supporting Customer Support, Player Support, Customer Experience, or a similar service operation.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, documentation, and stakeholder-management skills.

Nice to Have

  • Zendesk Administrator Certification or another relevant Zendesk certification.
  • Familiarity with Zendesk, Jira, or REST APIs, as well as Git or another version-control system.
  • Experience supporting gaming, SaaS, or high-volume support operations, including platform implementations, migrations, or transformation programs.

A portfolio demonstrating previous Zendesk work is preferred. Redacted screenshots, diagrams, dashboards, workflow designs, or anonymized examples are acceptable.

Shortlisted candidates may also be asked to complete and discuss a practical Zendesk case study based on a real-world player support scenario.

Keys for Success

Success in this role will be measured by your ability to:

  • Maintain a stable, secure, and well-governed Zendesk environment.
  • Deliver measurable improvements to operational efficiency, self-service, and player experience.
  • Maintain reliable reporting and effective collaboration between Zendesk, Jira, and operational teams.
  • Implement changes and improvement initiatives with clear documentation and minimal disruption to live operations
