VP, Growth and Sales: Life Sciences, Healthcare and Medical Devices

  • LocationUnited States, East Coast strongly preferred; remote with extensive travel
  • ReportingChief Business Officer, Healthcare and Life Sciences
  • MandateScale an established approximately​​​​​​​ ​​​​​​​$200M platform towards 9 figures multi-million dollar sales quota
  • Commercial focusNew logo acquisition and major new revenue creation, with selective strategic expansion

Company Overview:

Our client is a global technology services and consulting organization that combines industry expertise, digital engineering, cloud, data, enterprise platforms and business AI. The company operates across approximately 40 countries, employs more than 80,000 professionals and serves hundreds of major global enterprises. Its Healthcare and Life Sciences business is entering a deliberate scale phase built on strong domain capabilities, global delivery and established relationships across regulated industries.

The platform currently includes dedicated leaders for Life Sciences, Healthcare and Medical Devices. This newly created role will sit between those leaders and the Chief Business Officer, providing integrated commercial direction across the portfolio while keeping Life Sciences as the primary growth engine.

The mandate

  • Create and execute a unified growth strategy across Life Sciences, Healthcare and Medical Devices, with the majority of market attention, leadership energy and pipeline creation centered on Life Sciences.
  • Build a repeatable new logo engine and originate large, strategic opportunities. This is primarily a growth and sales leadership position, not a traditional account management role.
  • Help scale an existing combined business of approximately ​​​​​​​9 figures multi-million dollar sales quota platform through organic growth, stronger market coverage, larger pursuits and sharper sector positioning.
  • Provide commercial leadership across three established sector businesses, align their go to market priorities and create one coherent executive story for clients, partners and the market.
  • Translate deep industry knowledge into board and C suite conversations, differentiated propositions and complex transformation programs that combine consulting, technology, engineering and managed services.

Sector priorities

Life Sciences, the primary focus

The successful executive will bring current, credible and commercially useful knowledge across pharma and biotech, CROs and CDMOs, consumer health and the broader life sciences value chain. Relevant areas include discovery and development, clinical trials, regulatory and quality, manufacturing and supply chain, commercial launch, patient services, data and AI, cloud modernization, enterprise applications and digital operating models.

Medical Devices and MedTech

The role will also support growth with device and diagnostics companies through connected products, software and platform engineering, product lifecycle services, intelligent validation, quality and regulatory assurance, smart manufacturing, supply chain transformation and digital health.

Healthcare

Relevant healthcare experience may span payers, providers, pharmacy benefit managers and HealthTech. Priority themes include patient and member experience, core platform modernization, interoperability, data and analytics, responsible AI, value based care, operational optimization and secure cloud native transformation.

Key responsibilities

  • Own the growth agenda. Set the commercial strategy, priority markets, target account architecture and investment choices required to achieve the portfolio ambition.
  • Win new logos. Personally lead executive access, pursuit strategy and closing for major new clients, while building a disciplined team based origination engine.
  • Shape large deals. Work with consulting, delivery, engineering, alliances and solution teams to convert industry problems into differentiated, outcome based propositions and multiyear programs.
  • Build market credibility. Represent the organization with senior industry executives, boards, partners and ecosystem leaders. Strengthen the external point of view on AI, digital engineering and regulated transformation.
  • Integrate three businesses. Align Life Sciences, Healthcare and Medical Devices leadership around a common growth plan without losing the specialist depth of each sector.
  • Run a rigorous pipeline. Establish clear qualification, account prioritization, forecasting, deal governance and conversion disciplines. Maintain visibility into revenue, margin, risk and resource needs.
  • Develop leadership capacity. Coach senior sales and sector leaders, raise standards for consultative selling and create a collaborative culture that connects front end growth with delivery excellence.
  • Expand selectively. Use existing relationships when they can unlock substantial new programs, but keep the role centered on new revenue rather than routine farming or account administration.

Required experience

  • Approximately 15 or more years of progressive enterprise sales, business leadership or market development experience, including significant responsibility in global technology services, digital engineering, consulting or a highly relevant enterprise product organization.
  • Predominantly Life Sciences experience, with current or recent responsibility for selling into pharmaceutical, biotech or adjacent life sciences clients.
  • Meaningful exposure to Healthcare and Medical Devices, whether through current responsibility or earlier leadership assignments.
  • A documented record of opening major new logos and building large new revenue streams. Candidates whose experience is primarily account farming will not match the central mandate.
  • Experience carrying or influencing a nine figure portfolio, or leading a comparably complex scale up involving multiple industry segments, large pursuits and global delivery teams.
  • Executive relationships and a relevant network across pharmaceutical, biotech, MedTech, payer, provider or HealthTech organizations.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

raw.description:
Company Summary

Arlo Solutions (Arlo) is an information technology consulting services company that specializes in delivering technology solutions. Our reputation reflects the high quality of the talented Arlo Solutions team and the consultants working in partnership with our customers. Our mission is to understand and meet the needs of both our customers and consultants by delivering quality, value-added solutions. Our solutions are designed and managed to not only reduce costs, but to improve business processes, accelerate response time, improve services to end-users, and give our customers a competitive edge, now and into the future.

Position Overview

The Senior Manager, Talent Acquisition owns operational management of the full-lifecycle recruiting function — translating TA strategy into a running, measured operation across both pre-award (business development / proposal-stage) and post-award/internal (active contract delivery, Headquarters) hiring. This role is the operational backbone of TA and owns the ATS/HRIS environment the function runs on, builds and reports the KPI framework leadership uses to gauge hiring health, manages all TA vendor and staffing-partner relationships, and owns TA's compliance posture. The Senior Manager partners directly with the Director of HR on workforce and pipeline strategy so recruiting execution and broader HR workforce planning. This is a primarily remote position; some travel will be required to represent the company at recruitment events, job fairs, and conferences.

Work Location: Remote

Clearance: N/A

Job Responsibilities and/or Success Factors

  • Own day-to-day operations of the TA function — staffing cadence, requisition flow, SLA adherence, and escalation resolution across pre-award and post-award hiring
  • Partner with the Director of HR on workforce and pipeline strategy, translating headcount forecasts and contract growth into proactive sourcing plans
  • Own the TA KPI framework (time-to-fill, offer-acceptance rate, pipeline health) and present performance data to leadership
  • Drive process improvement across the recruiting lifecycle and own the JD library, interview guides, and sourcing playbooks
  • Manage TA vendor and staffing-partner relationships, including contract negotiation and performance accountability
  • Support HR with EEO/OFCCP recordkeeping, clearance-related hiring requirements, and audit readiness
  • Own ATS administration and partner with I.T. to drive the systems roadmap to support automation and reporting capabilities
  • Directly manage and develop the TA team, including performance management and career development
  • Represent the company at recruitment events, job fairs, and industry conferences as needed

Core Capabilities

  • Operational leadership: runs a multi-workstream function with competing SLAs and stakeholders
  • Data fluency: builds and interprets KPI dashboards, not just reads them
  • Vendor negotiation & contract management: comfortable owning cost and performance accountability for external partners
  • Compliance literacy: working knowledge of EEO/OFCCP and clearance-related hiring rules
  • ATS/HRIS administration: systems thinking, not just user-level familiarity
  • Executive communication: comfortable presenting performance data and recommendations to senior leadership
  • Remote team management: effective at leading and developing direct reports in a fully distributed environment

Education and Minimum Qualifications

  • 10+ years in Talent Acquisition, including 5+ years directly managing people in a TA leadership or recruiting-ops capacity
  • Experience recruiting in a government contracting / cleared environment strongly preferred (pre-award and post-award hiring)
  • Hands-on ATS administration experience (Greenhouse preferred) — configuration, reporting, and workflow design
  • Demonstrated experience managing vendor/staffing-partner relationships and contracts
  • Demonstrated ability to build and present KPI/SLA frameworks and dashboards to leadership
  • Understanding of EEO/OFCCP compliance requirements in a government-contracting environment
  • Strong stakeholder management skills — comfortable partnering with the Director of HR, PMs, Contracts, Finance, and customers
  • Comfortable working fully remote with periodic travel for recruitment events, job fairs, and conferences

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience recruiting in a government contracting / cleared environment (pre-award and post-award hiring)
  • Experience implementing recruiting automation or AI-assisted screening tools
  • Familiarity with subcontractor / Staffing Partner engagement models
  • HR or TA-related certification (e.g., AIRS, SHRM-CP) a plus

AAP Statement

We are proud to be an Affirmative Action and Equal Opportunity Employer and as such, we evaluate qualified candidates in full consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, national origin, age, disability status, protected veteran status, and any other protected status.

raw.description:
🚀 Help Transform the Future of Hiring at AssessFirst

AssessFirst is entering an exciting new phase of international growth, and we’re looking for a talented Mid-Market Account Executive to help accelerate our expansion across the UK.

About AssessFirst

Recruitment has changed. AI now helps candidates produce perfect CVs, LinkedIn profiles and cover letters, making it increasingly difficult to identify genuine potential.

At AssessFirst, we help organisations look beyond experience by using AI-powered talent intelligence to predict performance, motivation and long-term success. We believe recruitment should be more objective, inclusive and focused on potential rather than polished applications.

Today, more than 3,500 organisations across 40+ countries trust AssessFirst to make smarter hiring and talent decisions.

We’re a team of 110+ people with ambitious plans to become a global leader in Talent Intelligence.

The Opportunity

As our Mid-Market Account Executive, you’ll be responsible for winning new business across the UK Mid-Market, partnering with HR and Talent leaders to help them transform how they hire and develop talent.

This is a full-cycle sales role where you’ll generate opportunities, run consultative sales processes and close new customers. You’ll have the freedom to build your territory while working alongside our SDR and Marketing teams to create a healthy pipeline.

If you’re someone who enjoys building relationships, solving customer problems and closing business in a fast-paced SaaS environment, we’d love to hear from you.

What You’ll Do

Win New Business

  • Build and manage your own pipeline through outbound prospecting, referrals and inbound opportunities.

  • Qualify and progress new business opportunities across the UK Mid-Market.

  • Manage the full sales cycle from discovery through to negotiation and close.

  • Consistently achieve and exceed new business targets.

Sell Consultatively

  • Understand each customer’s hiring challenges and business objectives.

  • Deliver engaging product demonstrations tailored to customer needs.

  • Build business cases that demonstrate measurable commercial value.

  • Work with HR, Talent Acquisition, People Leaders and senior stakeholders to drive consensus.

Build Your Territory

  • Develop and execute territory plans.

  • Create opportunities through networking, LinkedIn and strategic outbound activity.

  • Collaborate closely with SDRs, Marketing and Customer Success to maximise commercial opportunities.

  • Maintain an active pipeline with disciplined opportunity management.

Drive Sales Excellence

  • Maintain accurate forecasting and CRM hygiene.

  • Manage opportunities through every stage of the sales process.

  • Apply structured sales methodologies and best practice.

  • Share market insight and customer feedback to help shape our commercial strategy.

Why Join AssessFirst?

You’ll be joining at one of the most exciting stages of our international growth.

You’ll benefit from:

  • Significant opportunity across the UK Mid-Market.

  • Freedom to sell across multiple industries.

  • A mature AI platform trusted by over 3,500 organisations globally.

  • Recognisable customers including AXA, Randstad, Greene King, Vision Express, Atos, Sellafield and The King’s Trust.

  • A collaborative, ambitious commercial team.

  • Genuine opportunities for career progression as we continue to grow internationally.

What We’re Looking For

💼 B2B SaaS Sales Experience

A proven track record of winning new business within B2B SaaS.

Ideally, you’ll have 2-5 years’ experience in a closing role, managing full sales cycles and consistently achieving quota.

🎯 Consultative Selling Skills

You’re naturally curious and customer-focused.

You enjoy uncovering business challenges, building value-led conversations and guiding prospects through a consultative buying journey.

Experience with sales methodologies such as MEDDPICC, Challenger, SPICED or similar would be beneficial.

🚀 Commercial Drive

You’re motivated by building pipeline, creating opportunities and winning new business.

You take ownership of your territory and enjoy working in a high-performance sales environment where effort and results are recognised.

🤝 Relationship Builder

You build trust quickly with HR, Talent and business leaders.

You’re confident presenting to decision-makers and managing multiple stakeholders throughout the buying process.

📈 Organised & Data-Driven

You’re disciplined in managing your pipeline, maintaining CRM accuracy and forecasting effectively.

You understand that consistent sales success comes from great habits as much as great conversations.

🇬🇧 Location & Language

  • Based in the UK.

  • Full right to work.

  • Fluent English.

What You’ll Receive

  • £55,000 base salary/£90,000 OTE

  • Remote-first working with genuine autonomy.

  • International career opportunities.

  • Collaborative, high-performance culture.

  • Opportunity to play a key role in AssessFirst’s global growth.

  • 7% employer pension contribution.

  • 25 days annual leave.

Recruitment Process

  1. Apply and complete the AssessFirst assessment.

  2. Introductory conversation with Talent.

  3. Mid-Market Sales Interview.

  4. Commercial case study.

  5. Final interview with our CRO and CEO

Ready to help redefine how organisations identify talent?

Join AssessFirst and help build the future of hiring.

raw.description:
Coupa makes margins multiply through its community-generated AI and industry-leading total spend management platform for businesses large and small. Coupa AI is informed by trillions of dollars of direct and indirect spend data across a global network of 10M+ buyers and suppliers. We empower you with the ability to predict, prescribe, and automate smarter, more profitable business decisions to improve operating margins.

Why join Coupa?

🔹 Pioneering Technology: At Coupa, we're at the forefront of innovation, leveraging the latest technology to empower our customers with greater efficiency and visibility in their spend.
🔹 Collaborative Culture: We value collaboration and teamwork, and our culture is driven by transparency, openness, and a shared commitment to excellence.
🔹 Global Impact: Join a company where your work has a global, measurable impact on our clients, the business, and each other.
Learn more on Life at Coupa blog and hear from our employees about their experiences working at Coupa.

What You'll Do:

    • Design and build the backend services behind the agent platform — the tool layer over Coupa APIs, context/state management, and the execution environment that keeps supplier data isolated.

    • Build the evaluation and logging pipeline: how we measure behavior, catch regressions, and turn production failures into fixed behaviors.

    • Partner with product and engineering to ship the first supplier-facing use cases (invoicing, catalog, strategic views) on the platform you build.

    • Own how the platform reaches production — deployment, configuration, scaling, and staying secure.

    • Make architectural calls on runtime isolation, credential handling, audit logging, and tenant separation.

    • Raise the engineering bar for the team — code quality, testing, and operational discipline.

What You Will Bring to Coupa:

  • Have 6+ years shipping production software and are strong in Python (TypeScript a plus).

  • Have built and operated services on a major cloud (AWS preferred) — containerized deployments, IaC, and the day-two work of keeping them running.

  • Have built backend services, platforms, or infrastructure that other engineers or systems depend on — APIs, SDKs, runtimes, internal platforms.

  • Have operated what you've built in production: you understand reliability, observability, failure modes, and least-privilege security, not just the application layer.

  • Write clean, well-tested code and reason about latency, failure modes, and user outcomes together, not as separate concerns.

  • Write and speak English fluently — the team operates in English and the work is prose-heavy.

  • Are comfortable working near LLMs — you don't need to have shipped an AI agent, but you should be curious about the space and quick to pick it up. Familiarity with LangChain / LangGraph or similar agent frameworks is a plus.

Bonus Points

  • A public GitHub, blog, or portfolio we can look at (strongly preferred — it's the fastest way for us to see how you think).

  • Are a daily user of agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or equivalents).

  • Have shipped an LLM-powered feature or product, and have opinions about why most of them don't work.

  • Experience with agent frameworks, eval tooling, or production LLM observability.

  • Hands-on with our specific stack — AWS Bedrock / AgentCore, LangGraph, or comparable managed-LLM and sandboxed-execution infrastructure.

  • Experience in procurement, fintech, or another regulated enterprise domain.

At Coupa, we are 100% committed to creating and nurturing an environment that supports your physical, mental, and community well-being . We offer a comprehensive suite of benefits designed to help you and your family thrive:
Global Well-Being Perks (For All Employees Globally)
  • Global Wellness Days: Enjoy two designated, company-wide paid wellness days off each year (typically the first Friday in March and the last Friday in September) so the entire global team can unplug, step away, and recharge together .
  • Birthday Time-Off: Celebrate your day! Coupa provides a paid day off on your birthday or another day of your choice within your birthday month .
  • Volunteer Time Off (VTO): Giving back is in our DNA. We offer 40 hours of paid VTO annually to support the community initiatives and volunteer programs you are passionate about .
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP): Access free, confidential, 24/7/365 counseling and resources for emotional support, work-life solutions, financial advice, legal guidance, and support for new parents .
  • Business Travel Protection: Travel with peace of mind. Zurich Travel Assist provides medical, safety, pre-trip planning, and emergency support during any business travel .
  • Referral Bonus Program: Share the Coupa experience! Receive generous monetary referral bonuses when you successfully refer talented friends or acquaintances who are hired into open roles .
Please note: In addition to these global well-being perks, Coupa offers highly competitive, location-specific benefits packages (which include comprehensive medical/dental insurance, retirement/pension plans, and life or accident protection) tailored to your primary work location. Your recruiter will walk you through the specific regional benefits package for this role during the interview process.
Coupa complies with relevant laws and regulations regarding equal opportunity and offers a welcoming and inclusive work environment. Decisions related to hiring, compensation, training, or evaluating performance are made fairly, and we provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified candidates and employees.
Please be advised that inquiries or resumes from recruiters will not be accepted.

raw.excerpt: Our PurposeAt SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future.
raw.description:
Our Purpose

At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.

About Us

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.

Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.

What Are We Looking For?

We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.

As a Content Creator, you will be the face and hands behind SentinelOne's short-form video content — shooting, editing and publishing platform-native videos that bring fresh, culture-forward storytelling from consumer, sports and political media into the cybersecurity space. You live in front of and behind the camera, you know how to make an audience stop scrolling in the first three seconds, and you turn complex security topics into content people actually want to watch.

This role has two paths depending on your background. If you bring technical or cybersecurity fluency, you'll also take the lead on growing and moderating our presence in community spaces like Reddit and Discord — building direct relationships with the practitioner audiences who live there. If your strength is video and storytelling rather than deep technical chops, you'll focus primarily on content production — but an interest in (or aptitude for) community management is a significant plus and something we're eager to develop in this role over time.

What Will You Do?

Primary responsibilities include:

  • Short-form video, first and foremost: Concept, shoot, edit and publish high-volume, platform-native video content (Reels, TikTok, Shorts, LinkedIn video and beyond) that translates cybersecurity topics into content with real cultural relevance
  • Own the on-camera presence: Be a consistent, recognizable voice for SentinelOne on social media. You are comfortable hosting, reacting, interviewing and improvising in front of a camera, not just producing content for others to appear in
  • Community engagement: Respond to and engage with customers, partners and security influencers across SentinelOne's channels and the broader social ecosystem
  • Drive cross-functional content strategy: Partner with demand generation, field marketing, threat intelligence, product marketing, talent brand and other teams, translating their objectives into video and social content that performs
  • Experimentation and growth: Stay on top of evolving platform features, formats and creator trends; borrow liberally from what's working in sports, consumer and political social to identify and test novel ways to grow SentinelOne's audience and community
  • Analytics & reporting: Work with comms leadership and the social media team to establish meaningful performance indicators and report on always-on content as well as specific campaigns

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

Ideal candidates will have:

  • A demonstrated track record as a hands-on, on-camera content creator — you can shoot, edit, write and publish short-form video without waiting on an agency or production team (a portfolio or reel is a must)
  • 2–5 years of experience creating content for a brand, publication, campaign or your own channel(s), ideally with time in or adjacent to consumer brands, sports media, political communications, entertainment, or directly within the cybersecurity ecosystem
  • Deep understanding of what makes video travel on TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, LinkedIn and X — including platform-specific formats, algorithms and audience behaviors
  • Technical or cybersecurity background and experience building or engaging with online communities (Reddit, Discord, Twitch, forums) is highly desired — candidates with this combination will expand community management capabilities as part of this role
  • Comfort translating complex, technical ideas into content that a broad audience wants to watch — cybersecurity expertise is a strong plus, but not a prerequisite for the video-first version of this role
  • Exceptional storytelling instincts, with range across tones (authoritative, punchy, human, urgent) and formats (talking-head, skits, interviews, reactive/trend content)
  • Proficiency with content creation and editing tools (e.g. CapCut, Edits, Premiere, Adobe Creative Suite) as well as social/community management tools and AI applications

Why SentinelOne?

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. Software Tester (QA Analyst)

We are seeking a mid-level Software Tester (QA Analyst) to plan and execute manual and automated testing for modern web applications, including AI-enabled features. You will create and maintain test cases, validate new features and defect fixes, track defects through resolution, and partner with Product Owners, developers, and other stakeholders in an Agile (SAFe/Scrum) environment. This role includes automation using Selenium WebDriver and S7, API testing (Postman/SoapUI), SQL-based data validation, Section 508 accessibility testing (JAWS), and the use of AI-assisted testing approaches with GenAI-supported test design and analysis. Ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance is required.

What You Will Do

  • Execute functional, smoke, regression, integration, and end-to-end testing for new features, enhancements, and defect fixes.
  • Create and maintain clear test cases, lightweight test plans, and traceability to requirements and acceptance criteria.
  • Design, implement, and maintain automated tests using Selenium WebDriver; contribute to a stable regression suite.
  • Perform API testing using Postman and/or SoapUI; validate responses, error handling, and data integrity.
  • Validate data and outcomes using SQL and other verification methods; ensure accuracy across UI, API, and database layers.
  • Support Section 508 accessibility testing using JAWS andhelpsvalidate usability expectations.
  • Test AI-enabled functionality (e.g., chat, summarization, intelligent search, recommendations) for quality, reliability, and user experience.
  • Use AI-assisted testing responsibly (e.g., GenAI to brainstorm test ideas, create test data, and support defect analysis) while maintaining human review and accountability.
  • Collaborate with product, engineering, security, and operations to identify risk areas (including role-based access, auditability, and sensitive data handling) and validate fixes.
  • Log, document, and track defects; verify fixes and support release validation in Agile/SAFe ceremonies.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent experience).
  • 4+ years of software testing/QA experience for enterprise web applications.
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum teams; SAFe experience is a plus.
  • Strong knowledge of test planning, test case design, regression suites, and defect management.
  • 3+ years of test automation experience using Selenium WebDriver (Selenium IDE is a plus) and Or Subject-7.
  • API testing experience using Postman and/or SoapUI, plus basic SQL skills for data validation.
  • Experience supporting Section 508 accessibility testing and using tools such as JAWS.
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted testing concepts and responsible use of Generative AI to support test design and analysis.
  • Experience with QA and collaboration tools (e.g., Jira, Azure DevOps, TestRail, Confluence, or similar).
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with CI/CD-integrated testing, test reporting, and release validation.
  • Experience coding/scripting (Java preferred) to support automation and test utilities.
  • Performance/load testing exposure.
  • Experience using AI-driven test automation, self-healing test tools, visual validation tools, or intelligent regression testing platforms.
  • Hands-on experience testing AI-enabled user experiences (e.g., chat, summarization, intelligent search) including evaluation approaches such as rubrics, golden datasets, and prompt regression.
  • Experience validating behavior involving role-based access, auditability, workflow controls, and sensitive or regulated data.
  • Experience supporting testing in government or other compliance-driven environment.

raw.title: Senior Product Analyst

raw.description:
Fully Remote (UK based) | Competitive Salary + Bonus + Generous Equity | B Corp Certified
TrustedHousesitters is a fast growing, direct-to-consumer marketplace that is redefining pet care and travel.
Here at TrustedHousesitters, we’re on a mission to make travel work better for pets, for their people, and for the global community of animal lovers who look after them. We’ve got big plans on becoming the world’s most-loved travel solution for pet people. We’ve built something pretty special: a trusted place where pet owners and sitters connect to keep pets happy at home while their humans explore the world.
We’ve already grown into a global community with members in over 140 countries, a product people genuinely love, and a team of more than 100 brilliant humans powering it all.
But we’re only just getting started. Our goal? To grow to 1 million members and make TrustedHousesitters the world’s most-loved travel solution for pet people.
At the moment, a sit starts every two minutes somewhere on the planet. We want that to be every single minute and we know the only way we’ll get there is with the right people in the right roles.
The right people in the right roles will shape our future. So, here’s the big question: Could that be you?

Fifty million people in the UK and US alone could be Trusted Housesitters members. Around forty thousand people land on trustedhousesitters.com every day. What happens next - whether they trust us enough to sign up, and what we do to help them succeed once they have - is one of the most interesting analytical challenges we have right now. This role owns that: what happens once someone's actually inside the product.

You'll own the analytics for our new member revenue product squads. Own the journey, own the experiments on it, own the recommendations that come out of it. You'll be the person who doesn't just explain what happened in the data - you'll have a point of view on what to do about it. We're looking for someone who goes looking for the questions nobody's asked yet.

What you'll actually be doing

  • Own the growth analytics for our new member revenue squads - acquisition funnel, conversion, product usage, the works - and build a picture of what's actually driving (or blocking) that journey.
  • Spot opportunities in the data before anyone asks you to look. Turn them into recommendations that change what gets built, not just what gets reported
  • Lead instrumentation on new features - defining tracking, success metrics, and guardrail metrics before anything ships, not after
  • Design and run A/B and multivariate experiments on the product itself - page layouts, signup flows, onboarding journey - end-to-end from hypothesis through to decision-ready insight. Set the standard for how experimentation works across the product squads
  • Build the dashboards and self-serve reporting that means stakeholders can answer their own questions - and you spend less time running the same queries every Monday
  • Challenge assumptions. Act as the analytical voice in the room when product and commercial decisions are being made. Be the comfortable person saying "I don't think that's what the data shows"
  • Mentor other analysts and help raise the analytical bar across the team - in SQL, in experimentation, in how we tell a story with numbers

What we're looking for

  • Solid product analytics experience in a subscription, marketplace, SaaS, or platform business - where the funnel is complex, and the metrics actually matter
  • The ability to own end-to-end analysis for a product area, from scoping through to recommendation, with minimal direction
  • Advanced SQL. You're not reaching for documentation for standard analytical patterns. dbt experience is a genuine plus
  • Good understanding of user event tracking (Segment, Amplitude, Mixpanel, or similar) - you're comfortable defining new events to support release of new product features, and to enable future analysis and reporting.
  • Solid understanding of experimentation - hypothesis design, A/B and multivariate testing, statistical significance, the places where naive analysis goes wrong. And experience applying it, not just describing it
  • Fluency in product metrics: conversion, activation, churn - and how those numbers connect to things the business actually cares about
  • Strong data storytelling. You can explain what the numbers mean to a product manager, and also to a CFO. Different rooms, different language, same rigour
  • Product instincts. This isn't just an analytics role. We want someone who generates ideas, not just validates them

Nice to have

  • Python or R for more advanced modelling or automation
  • Experience integrating AI tools into analytical workflows in a way that's actually made a difference

You might feel like a fish out of water if...

    We know this isn't what you'd see in most job ads - but TrustedHousesitters isn't most companies.

    Trust, transparency, and honest feedback aren't just things we say; they're genuinely how we operate, every day. So rather than leaving you guessing if things don't work out, we'd rather give you what you need to make a great decision upfront about whether this opportunity is right for you.

    With that in mind, here are a few things worth considering before you hit apply.

    You're most comfortable when the question is handed to you. This role needs someone who goes looking for the question. If your best work tends to happen when a stakeholder has defined the problem clearly, and you're building the analysis to answer it - that's a genuinely valuable skill, just not quite the shape of this one.

    You think of experimentation as a process to follow, not a discipline to own. We're not looking for someone who can run an A/B test to spec. We're looking for someone who'll push back when the experiment is designed badly, mentor others through the parts they get wrong, and build the frameworks that make the whole team better at it.

    You're most excited by media spend and channel strategy. This role sits inside the product, not the media plan - if deciding where ad budget goes, or building attribution and channel-mix models, is the part that lights you up, this wouldn't be the right fit on this occasion

    You're happiest when the business is stable, and the roadmap is fixed. THS is growing fast, and the product is evolving constantly. The analytical picture shifts. Priorities shift. That's the job - and if predictability is important to how you do your best work, it's worth naming that upfront.

    If you're reading this and one of those points resonates, and you're sitting there thinking "that's me, but I know I can make it work" - we'd love to hear why. Send a Cover letter. There's a human at the heart of every decision we make here (hi!) - and we'll always take the time to review applications for anyone who wants to join us.

The Process

    We value your time and aim for a transparent, efficient process:

    1. Intro call (~20 mins) - with the Talent team. A two-way conversation: we'll tell you more about the role and THS, you tell us about your background and what you're looking for

    2. Hiring manager interview (~30 mins) - with the Product Analytics Lead. Covering your analytical experience, approach to experimentation, and how you think about growth problems

    3. Take-home task (~1-.5 hours) - a short analytical exercise. We'll share a brief in advance and give you time to work through it at your own pace

In addition to a competitive salary and bonus, we offer a range of benefits, including:

🐾 For the love of pets

  • Each year, you’ll get a Premium TrustedHousesitters Combined membership which includes benefits like free airport lounge passes, Sit Cancellation Plan and Home and Contents Plan, plus five Premium memberships to gift to friends and family
  • Our team can work remotely from as many house sits as they like, and we contribute up to £500 per

As a growing company, our Solutions Engineers play a pivotal role—collaborating across Marketing, Product Management, and Engineering to bridge the gap between market needs and product innovation. If you thrive in an environment where your technical expertise fuels real business impact, and where your insights help shape the future of our platform, you’ll feel right at home here.

What we look for in this role

raw.description:
Our Purpose

At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.

About Us

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.

Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.

What Are We Looking For?

We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.

As a CRO Specialist, you will own the day-to-day execution of our web experimentation program - and to be the analytical engine that powers it. This role sits within our broader Web UX team and is responsible for the full testing lifecycle: from behavioral research and hypothesis development to experiment setup, QA, and post-test reporting.

You'll be our resident expert in Webflow Optimize, a close partner to the Manager of UX Design & CRO, and the person who ensures every experiment we run is well-designed, rigorously tracked, and thoroughly documented. This isn't just a button-pushing role; we're looking for someone who brings genuine curiosity about user behavior, strong analytical instincts, and the operational discipline to keep a high-velocity testing program running smoothly.

What Will You Do?

Primary responsibilities include:

Behavioral Research & Insight

  • Analyze heatmaps, session recordings, FullStory, and GA4 to identify friction points, drop-off patterns, and conversion opportunities across the site
  • Document behavioral findings and translate them into clear, prioritized observations that inform test ideas, UX improvements, and design decisions
  • Surface insights to the broader web team to contribute to UX strategy — not just the testing pipeline

Test Ideation & Hypothesis Development

  • Generate data-backed test ideas and write structured hypotheses that clearly articulate the problem, proposed change, and expected outcome
  • Collaborate with the Manager to align the test backlog with the CRO strategy and business priorities
  • Track prior experiments to build on learnings and avoid redundancy

Testing Roadmap & Pipeline Execution

  • Own and maintain the monthly testing roadmap, keeping it accurate and prioritized
  • Manage every test through the full pipeline - brief, Asana ticket creation, design coordination, dev handoff, QA, launch, and monitoring
  • Maintain clear documentation and ticket hygiene so stakeholders always have visibility into test status

Experiment Setup & QA

  • Configure all experiments in Webflow Optimize, including audience segmentation, traffic allocation, goal tracking, and variant logic
  • Own pre-launch QA across devices and browsers, verifying tracking, rendering, and experiment logic
  • Monitor live tests for data quality and flag anomalies or early signals to the Manager

Webflow Optimize Expertise

  • Serve as the team's go-to expert on Webflow Optimize - understanding its full capabilities and best practices
  • Stay current on platform updates and proactively identify ways to run more sophisticated experiments
  • Train or support other team members on the tool as needed

Reporting & Knowledge Management

  • Write a detailed post-test report for every experiment - results, statistical significance, segment analysis, and a clear win/loss/inconclusive call
  • Maintain the CRO testing deck as an organized, up-to-date knowledge base that the wider company can reference
  • Partner with the Manager on site-wide KPI tracking and contribute to monthly and quarterly performance reporting

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

Ideal candidates will have:

  • 2-4 years of experience in CRO, digital marketing, UX research, or web analytics
  • Hands-on experience setting up and managing A/B tests in an experimentation platform (Webflow Optimize, Optimizely, VWO, or similar)
  • Proficiency with behavioral analytics tools (FullStory, Hotjar, or equivalent) and comfort with heatmaps and session recordings
  • Working knowledge of GA4 for funnel analysis and performance tracking
  • Strong written communication skills - able to write clear hypotheses, experiment briefs, and post-test reports
  • Organized and process-oriented, with experience managing multiple workstreams or projects simultaneously
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret experiment data and translate it into actionable recommendations
  • Experience working within a B2B SaaS or enterprise marketing organization

Why SentinelOne?

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place.

We invest in our Sentinels with comprehensive, competitive benefits designed to support you and your family:

  • Restricted Stock Units (RSUs)
  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)

Time Off & Wellbeing

  • Flexible time off
  • Paid company holidays and paid sick time
  • Gender-neutral parental leave
  • Grandparent leave

Insurance & Financial Security

  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • 401(k) retirement plan with company match
  • Life and disability insurance
  • Health and dependent care FSA
  • Voluntary benefits (hospital, accident, critical illness)
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • ARAG pre-paid legal
  • Nationwide pet insurance
  • Cancer Care program
  • Global business travel medical insurance

Work Perks & Flexibility

  • Home office allowance
  • Mobile phone reimbursement

Wellness & Lifestyle

  • Wellness coach
  • Wellness/gym reimbursement
  • Fertility coverage
  • Adoption & surrogacy reimbursement

The Senior Director, LTSS Service Determinations provides enterprise leadership and strategic oversight for all LTSS Service Determination operations across CareSource's Medicaid, Dual Eligible, and LTSS markets. The Senior Director establishes enterprise standards, policies, workflows, and performance expectations to ensure consistent, timely, and regulatory-compliant authorization and service determination decisions across all markets. In partnership with Clinical, Operations, Compliance, Quality, and Market Leadership, this role drives operational excellence, workforce planning, regulatory readiness, process transformation, and scalable growth strategies to support evolving business, member, and regulatory needs.

  • Business acumen and politically astute ability to act with diplomacy and sensitivity to cultural diversity

Now Hiring: Contract Staff Attorney
The Devenere Law Collective (DLC) was built from a vision shaped by years of experience across multiple areas of law and a deep commitment to collaboration, innovation, and community. What began as a journey through the evolving challenges of the legal profession grew into something greater—a collective of like-minded attorneys dedicated to providing strategic, client-centered legal services. Today, DLC continues to grow as a modern, inclusive ﬁrm where diverse perspectives are valued and attorneys are empowered to thrive. We are currently seeking a Contract Staff Attorney to join our expanding team.

Position Overview
This is a contract-based role for an experienced civil litigation attorney who is conﬁdent managing complex matters, appearing in both state and federal court, and maintaining a consistent caseload in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

Key Responsibilities & Duties
• Manage a caseload of civil litigation matters from inception through resolution
• Draft, review, and ﬁle pleadings, motions, and federal court ﬁlings
• Conduct legal research and develop strategic case approaches
• Represent clients in state and federal court hearings, mediations, and trials
• Handle all phases of discovery, including depositions, interrogatories, and document
production
• Ensure compliance with federal and state procedural rules and court deadlines
• Communicate effectively with clients, opposing counsel, and court personnel
• Provide case evaluations and legal recommendations
• Collaborate with internal team members, including case managers and support staff
• Maintain accurate and timely billing records to meet required billable hours

Required Qualiﬁcations
• Licensed in the State of Texas
• Minimum 8+ years of legal practice
• Must be knowledgeable in three or more of the following practice areas:
(i) Probate/Estate Planning;
(ii) Real Estate;
(iii) Business Transaction & Litigation; and
(iv) Family Law.
• Demonstrated experience in civil litigation (required)
• Trial experience (required)
• Ability to meet a minimum of 60 billable hours bi-weekly (120+ hours per month)
• Strong ability to independently manage cases and deadlines
• Ability to accept fulltime employment after expiration of contract
• Capability to go to court within Harris County and any of the contiguous counties

Preferred Qualiﬁcations
• Experience handling federal litigation matters
• Strong written and oral advocacy skills

What We’re Looking For
We value diverse perspectives and are seeking driven attorneys who bring professionalism, empathy, and a client-centered approach. The ideal candidate is adaptable, detail-oriented, and thrives in a collaborative legal environment.

Work Structure
• Contract position for 6+ months minimum
• Minimum 120+ hours per month required
• Although this position is remote, the Attorney must be available for court appearances as needed
• Ability to accept fulltime employment after expiration of contract
If you are a motivated, federally licensed civil litigation attorney looking to join a growing,
forward-thinking legal collective, we encourage you to apply.

Appearance Attorneys in the following areas:
• Business Litigation
• Probate
• Construction Litigation
• Family/Guardianships
• Civil Litigation
Contract Attorneys (Immediate Need):
• One Family Law Attorney
• One Civil Litigation Attorney (must be federally licensed)
Apply today to become part of The Devenere Law Collective.

raw.description:
Mindrift is looking for skilled Mobile App Developers (React Native, Flutter, Swift, or Kotlin) to join the Tendem project () and build native and cross-platform mobile applications for real-world use cases. In this role, you'll apply your mobile engineering expertise to build stable, performant, and user-friendly applications for iOS and Android. This part-time remote opportunity is ideal for professionals with hands-on experience shipping iOS and/or Android apps, working with platform APIs, and handling the full mobile development lifecycle.

What We Do

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with innovative technology projects. Our mission is to help develop high-quality AI technologies by combining real-world expertise from professionals across the globe with advanced AI development efforts.

About the Role

This is a freelance role for a Tendem project. As a Mobile App Developer, you'll design, build, and refine mobile applications across categories such as utilities, fitness/wellness, games, productivity, delivery, and content apps — for iOS, Android, or both, using native or cross-platform frameworks.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build mobile applications using React Native, Flutter, Swift (iOS), or Kotlin (Android).
  • Implement responsive mobile UIs that follow platform conventions (iOS HIG, Material Design).
  • Integrate native device features (camera, push notifications, location, storage, biometrics).
  • Connect apps to backend APIs, handle offline state, caching, and synchronization.
  • Implement monetization features where required (in-app purchases, ads, subscriptions).
  • Review, debug, optimize, and refactor mobile application code to improve correctness, performance, battery efficiency, and maintainability.
  • Debug platform-specific issues and prepare builds for distribution (TestFlight, Play Console).

Educational qualifications

  • At least 3 years of relevant experience in mobile app development (required).
  • Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or related technical fields is a plus.

Academic and/or Professional Experience

Candidates should have a strong foundation in mobile application development, platform-specific UI/UX patterns, and building stable, high-quality mobile experiences for iOS and Android. We are looking for specialists who can confidently work with native or cross-platform frameworks, integrate device APIs and backend services, and build production-ready mobile applications. Strong attention to detail, performance awareness, and the ability to work independently are essential.

Technical Skills (Essential)

  • Hands-on experience with at least one of: React Native, Flutter, Swift/SwiftUI (iOS), or Kotlin/Jetpack Compose (Android).
  • Solid understanding of mobile UI patterns, navigation, state management, and platform guidelines.
  • Experience integrating REST APIs, handling async data, and managing local storage.
  • Familiarity with native device APIs (notifications, camera, location, storage, biometrics).
  • Experience with mobile build tools, code signing, and submission to App Store / Google Play.
  • Experience implementing in-app purchases, ads, or subscriptions is a plus.
  • Familiarity with backend services such as Firebase, Supabase, or similar is a plus.

Additional requirements

  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to performance, stability, and platform polish.
  • Self-directed work ethic with the ability to ship complete mobile features independently.
  • Portfolio of shipped mobile apps (required, with App Store / Google Play links preferred).
  • English proficiency: Upper-intermediate (B2) or above (required)

Project time expectations

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10–20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active.

Compensation

On this project, contributors can earn up to $30 per hour equivalent, depending on their level and pace of contribution.

Compensation varies across projects depending on scope, complexity, and required expertise. Please note that other projects on the platform may offer different earning levels based on their requirements.

Why this freelance opportunity might be a great fit for you?

  • Work fully remote on your own schedule with just a laptop and stable internet connection.
  • Apply your expertise to real-world technology projects while gaining experience building high-quality solutions for a global platform.
  • Participate in performance-based bonus programs that reward high-quality work and consistent delivery.

raw.description:
Who we are

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.

.

Hiring and how we work :

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.

.

Who we are

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next Incident Commander

About the job

This position is needed to help own and strategically evolve Twilio's incident response function as one of the company's Incident Commanders. You will be capable of facilitating incidents across the full range of severities, including our highest-severity incidents. You will orchestrate response across a wide range of business functions, not just engineering. VPs, C-suite leaders, Triage Engineers, Incident Owners, and customer facing teams will turn to you for a clear, accurate read on what's happening and what's next. You approach every incident with genuine curiosity, pushing past the first plausible explanation to find what's really going on, and bring that same curiosity to the retrospective once the dust settles. Beyond the incident bridge, you will own and influence the incident response process and tooling strategy for the company. Helping set company-wide response standards, defining response OKRs, and driving cross-org adoption of the practices that reduce MTTR and prevent recurrence. This position is part of a global team with a follow-the-sun model and requires working effectively with teams across multiple timezones and geo-locations.

Responsibilities

In this role, you will:

  • Serve as Incident Commander across the full range of severities, including our most critical, cross-functional incidents. Orchestrate the incident process company-wide, own the accuracy of incident data, and set standards for how IR lifecycle milestones are met.
  • Enforce incident response practices at all levels and shape which industry best practices Twilio adopts. Identify cross-org gaps and push product groups to prioritize fixes that delay MTTR or block the IR lifecycle. Run multiple concurrent workstreams, deviating from standard process when needed, even across simultaneous incidents.
  • Keep stakeholders informed with clear, timely updates during critical incidents as well as project development. Own key Incident Command documentation and keep it current through change management. Drive quality and accuracy in incident data company-wide.
  • Bring genuine curiosity to every incident, while maintaining focus on incident mitigation and customer communications. Carry that same curiosity into Post Incident Review, helping Incident Owners surface real contributing factors and repair items.
  • Help Product Managers deliver high-quality Reason For Outage documents within SLO, and drive Product Groups to meet their incident response SLOs. Escalate customer issues to the right people, during and after an incident.
  • Lead cross-org projects end-to-end with Product Group leadership and Program Managers. Influence company-wide standards. Evaluate new tools and technology, and represent Twilio externally as a thought leader in incident response.

Qualifications

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

Required:

  • 5+ years leading high-severity incident response, including as incident commander for the most critical incidents at a company operating at meaningful scale.
  • Proven ability to influence and enforce incident practices at the Director/VP/C-suite level without formal authority; comfortable being the calm, authoritative voice in the room regardless of who's in it.
  • Experience partnering across functions beyond engineering (e.g. Security, Support, Product) during incident response.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with experience conveying incident status and risk clearly to executives and customer-facing teams.
  • Ability to size up a situation and make rapid decisions on the right course of action, including across multiple concurrent incidents.
  • Deep understanding of the incident response lifecycle (Gameday, Incident Response, PIR, Betterments), including defining or refining it for an organization.
  • Ability to lead cross-org projects end-to-end: defining milestones, managing risk, and driving them through formal change management.
  • A curious, investigative mindset, asking "why" past the first plausible answer, both live during an incident and in Post Incident Review, to find what's actually going on.

Desired:

  • Understanding of modern engineering tech stack and tooling.
  • Experience with Twilio products and services.
  • Certification(s) in Incident Management (CEIM), Security Incident Management (CSIRT), program management/project management, Six Sigma, Scrum, or similar.

Location

This role will be remote and based in the UK.

Travel

For this role, you may be offered to travel to participate in project meetings, however travel opportunities are minimal.

What we offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.

.

Stay alert to recruitment fraud

We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @ email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps.

.

Twilio is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Additionally, Twilio participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law.

Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.

Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional-grade APIs. This includes broker-dealers, investment advisors, wealth managers, hedge funds, and crypto exchanges, totalling over 10 million brokerage accounts.

Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. We're deeply committed to open-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award-winning, developer-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it.

Alpaca is proudly backed by $400 million in funding from top-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator.

Our Team Members:

We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!

We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

As a senior software engineer, you will help build and scale the systems and services that form the foundation of Alpaca and empower millions of users who are trading billions of dollars worth of assets.

The market data team is responsible for improving the overall architecture of Alpaca connected to data products such as stocks, options, crypto, and foreign exchange markets. Oversee their public API structure and documentation on both streaming and historical endpoints. The team is responsible for building a cohesive developer-first API and is tasked with planning, ideating, experimenting, and putting into production the new services, and libraries that overcome some of our greatest technical challenges as we continue to scale rapidly.

We are looking for senior or staff engineers who are keen on providing quality solutions, have great fundamentals, have proven experience building and architecting at scale, and are not afraid of challenging conventions. This demanding team also requires a deep understanding of POSIX-like operating systems, modern infrastructure, and orchestration practices.

Things You Get To Do:

  • Influence the overall architecture of Alpaca’s market data systems
  • Design highly scalable, mission-critical systems
  • Obsess over latency (every nanosecond counts)
  • Implement backend services and lead architecture where scalability and resilience matters
  • Maintain good software quality and test coverage
  • Participate in code reviews
  • Troubleshooting on incidents and reported bugs
  • You may be asked to be on-call to assist with engineering projects that are timely in nature

Who You Are (Must-Haves):

  • At least 4 years of experience working on systems at scale
  • Experience with at least compiled imperative languages (e.g. Go, C, C++, Rust, etc.). Most of our critical services are written in Go
  • SQL or relational database skills
  • Familiarity with TCP/IP, and UDP networking
  • Proficient with Linux/BSD, and shell scripting
  • Excited about what we are building at Alpaca
  • Proven track record of architecting and leading medium-scale projects involving multiple teams
  • Experience with Kubernetes or other workload orchestration and scheduling systems (we primarily use Kubernetes via GKE)
  • Experience with major cloud platforms (we primarily use GCP)
  • A passion for financial markets

Who You Might Be (Nice-to-Haves):

  • Experience with Market Data
  • Knowledge of microservice architectures
  • Knowledge of clean code principles
  • DevOps mindset is an asset
  • Cloud Networking experience (BGP, VPC peering)
  • Experience in building low-latency applications
  • Experience with distributed key-value stores
  • Experience with CI/CD
  • A passion for financial markets or the desire to learn
  • Knowledge of Agile/Scrum methodologies
  • Experience with observability, tracing, continuous profiling
  • Experience with capacity planning and benchmarking

How We Take Care of You:

  • Competitive Salary & Stock Options
  • Health Benefits
  • New Hire Home-Office Setup: One-time USD $500
  • Monthly Stipend: USD $150 per month via a Brex Card

Alpaca is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to pursuing and hiring a diverse workforce.

raw.description:
At Forbes Advisor, our mission is to help readers turn their aspirations into reality. We arm people with trusted advice and guidance so they can make informed decisions they feel confident in and get back to doing the things they care about most.

We are an experienced team of industry experts dedicated to helping readers make smart decisions and choose the right products with ease. Forbes Advisor boasts decades of experience across dozens of geographies and teams, including Content, SEO, Business Intelligence, Finance, HR, Marketing, Production, Technology and Sales. The team brings rich industry knowledge to Forbes Advisor's global coverage of consumer credit, debt, health, home improvement, banking, investing, credit cards, small business, education, insurance, loans, real estate and travel.

We are hiring a Principal Designer to lead growth design at Forbes Advisor. You will architect end-to-end paid acquisition funnels across our verticals, pairing advertorials and pre-landers with interactive quizzes, calculators, and conversion flows tailored to specific audience personas. Ad creative sits with a separate team. Your scope starts at the click and ends at the conversion.

You will report into the Head of Design and partner closely with Paid Media, Growth, Editorial, and Engineering. We are looking for a designer who thinks in funnels and personas, writes their own headlines when needed, designs interactive tools as confidently as static pages, and treats every CRO mechanic as a design problem. If you live at the intersection of editorial craft and direct response, and you are excited to apply that craft across categories where small conversion gains move real money, this role is for you.

Responsibilities:

  • Funnel Architecture: Design paid acquisition funnels end to end. Own the path from the moment a user lands through to lead capture or quote completion across our paid social consumer experiences.
  • Persona Translation: Build multiple funnel variants per vertical, each tailored to a distinct audience. The same offer reads differently to a healthcare worker carrying credit card debt, a skeptical cat owner, or a first-time puppy parent. Design to the segment.
  • Interactive Tools: Design quizzes, calculators, and qualification flows with branching logic and state, and leveraging AI tools in prototyping these experiences.
  • Editorial Long-Form: Design advertorials, pre-landers, and listicles that hold attention and drive action. Translate Forbes Advisor's editorial voice into formats engineered to convert.
  • Conversion Engineering: Treat CRO mechanics as a design discipline. Micro-commitments, loading screens, exit intent, progressive capture, post-submit handoffs. You have opinions on each and can defend them.
  • Experimentation and Production: Run hypothesis-driven tests across every surface you own. Build the templates and component systems that let the team ship persona and funnel variants at volume without losing quality.
  • Mentorship: Mentor designers and contributors on funnel thinking, persona design, and experimentation discipline. Help shape hiring as the function scales.

Requirements:

  • 10+ years of experience in growth design, performance funnel design, or direct response design at a high bar
  • Portfolio showing measurable conversion impact tied to specific design decisions. CVR, lead quality, CAC, or revenue movement. We will weight performance evidence heavily
  • Demonstrated experience designing complete funnels end to end, not just isolated pages. You can talk through the logic of a funnel you architected and the personas it served
  • Direct response sensibility. You understand hook, proof, payoff, and CTA structure, and can write a strong headline when needed
  • Experience designing interactive tools (quizzes, calculators, qualification flows) with branching logic and state
  • Experience running structured experimentation programs and translating performance data into design direction
  • Strong web design fundamentals (layout, typography, hierarchy, information design) and fluency in Figma plus at least one prototyping tool, preferably Cursor but open to other tools.
  • Editorial sensibility. You can design long-form content that meets Forbes editorial standards while still driving action
  • AI-native execution. You use AI as a production accelerator and have a clear point of view on where it helps and where it gets in the way
  • Strong written and verbal communication. You can pitch directions, defend decisions with data, and influence cross-functional partners
  • Timezone: UK or US, with flexibility to overlap with CST stakeholders

Nice to haves:

  • Experience in funnel optimization and conversion-focused design.
  • Background in performance design at an in-house growth team, performance agency, DTC brand, or CPA/affiliate marketing operation
  • Experience designing interactive quiz or calculator funnels
  • Familiarity with analytics and testing stacks such as GA4, Clarity, Tableau, or Optimizely
  • Experience scaling conversion experiences against a meaningful paid budget

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. The role will include a blend of areas from reviewing transactions in real-time to prevent fraud, identifying fraudulent activities/ patterns, account takeovers, and handling internal escalations to provide services through the Instacart platform and much more.

This is a 6-month contracted position at Instacart with expectations to work 40 hours/week. This is a non-exempt position, paid hourly, and eligible for additional hours as necessary. You will be scheduled to work 1 or 2 weekend days which your manager will assign to your schedule based on your availability.

Instacart's Fraud & Identity team takes data-driven, customer-first approaches to ensure we are compliant with all local, state and federal regulations regarding grocery fulfillment. In this role, you will be responsible for executing on processes critical to ensuring the Instacart platform remains secure, safe, and stable for all users.

  • Maintain a queue of inbound customer appeals with time management and prioritization skills

We empower innovation with an unparalleled commitment to build faster, safer software and harness AI and data intelligence to mitigate risk, maximize efficiencies, and drive powerful software development.

More than 2,000 organizations, including 70% of the Fortune 100 and 15 million software developers, rely on Sonatype to optimize their software supply chains.

As the Channel Sales Manager - West Coast, you will serve as a vital enterprise catalyst in Sonatype’s strategic acceleration toward our $500M revenue milestone. Sitting at the intersection of West Coast enterprise outbound expansion and ecosystem leverage, this role exists to build, scale, and orchestrate a high-performing commercial partner network across the West Coast territory (targeting Tier-1 partners including Optiv, Guidepoint, Presidio, CDW, and premier regional solution providers).

Artificial Intelligence is accelerating code creation by 5x, causing an exponential expansion of open-source dependency risk and machine-speed malware ingestion. You will position Sonatype Firewall (>100% YoY growth) as the market's leading commercial wedge and lead joint co-selling strategies across our partner ecosystem.

As an Enterprise Builder and Work Designer, you will embody Sonatype's EVP by embedding AI-driven efficiencies into partner enablement, pipeline forecasting, and joint account mapping. You will not merely manage legacy reseller channels; you will architect an outbound force multiplier that elevates Sonatype's market leadership across West Coast enterprise accounts.

Role outcomes:

    • Strategic Responsibilities
